texts.num.32.3: Ataroth, e Dibon, e Jaezer, e Nimra, e Hesbon, e Eleal, e Schebam, e Nebo, e Behon;
texts.num.32.4: A terra que o Senhor feriu diante da congregação de Israel, é terra de gado: e os teus servos teem gado.
texts.num.32.5: Disseram mais: Se achámos graça aos teus olhos, dê-se esta terra aos teus servos em possessão; e não nos faças passar o Jordão.
texts.num.32.6: Porém Moysés disse aos filhos de Gad e aos filhos de Ruben: Irão vossos irmãos á peleja, e ficareis vós aqui?
texts.num.32.7: Porque pois descorajaes o coração dos filhos d’Israel, para que não passem á terra que o Senhor lhes tem dado?
texts.num.32.8: Assim fizeram vossos paes, quando os mandei de Cades-barnea, a ver esta terra.
texts.num.32.9: Chegando elles até ao valle d’Escol, e vendo esta terra, descorajaram o coração dos filhos de Israel, para que não viessem á terra que o Senhor lhes tinha dado.
texts.num.32.10: Então a ira do Senhor se accendeu n’aquelle mesmo dia, e jurou, dizendo:
texts.num.32.11: Que os varões, que subiram do Egypto, de vinte annos e para cima não verão a terra que jurei a Abrahão, a Isaac, e a Jacob porquanto não perseveraram em seguir-me;
texts.num.32.12: Excepto Caleb, filho de Jefoné o kenezeo, e Josué filho de Nun, porquanto perseveraram em seguir ao Senhor.
texts.num.32.13: Assim se accendeu a ira do Senhor contra Israel, e fêl-os andar errantes até que se consumiu toda aquella geração, que fizera mal aos olhos do Senhor.
texts.num.32.14: E eis-que vós, uma multidão de homens peccadores, vos levantastes em logar de vossos paes, para ainda mais accrescentar o furor da ira do Senhor contra Israel.
texts.num.32.15: Se vós vos virardes de seguil-o, tambem elle os deixará de novo no deserto, e destruireis a todo este povo.
texts.num.32.16: Então chegaram-se a elle, e disseram: Edificaremos curraes aqui para o nosso gado, e cidades para as nossas crianças;
texts.num.32.17: Porém nós nos armaremos, apressando-nos diante dos d’Israel, até que os levemos ao seu logar: e ficarão as nossas crianças nas cidades fortes por causa dos moradores da terra.
texts.num.32.18: Não voltaremos para nossas casas, até que os filhos d’Israel estejam de posse cada um da sua herança.
texts.num.32.19: Porque não herdaremos com elles d’além do Jordão, nem mais adiante; porquanto nós já teremos a nossa herança d’áquem do Jordão ao oriente.
texts.num.32.20: Então Moysés lhes disse: Se isto fizerdes assim, se vos armardes á guerra perante o Senhor;
texts.num.32.21: E cada um de vós, armado, passar o Jordão perante o Senhor, até que haja lançado fóra os seus inimigos de diante d’elle;
texts.num.32.22: E a terra esteja subjugada perante o Senhor; então voltareis depois, e ficareis desculpados perante o Senhor e perante Israel: e esta terra vos será por possessão perante o Senhor:
texts.num.32.23: E se não fizerdes assim, eis que peccastes contra o Senhor: porém sentireis o vosso peccado, quando vos achar.
texts.num.32.24: Edificae vós cidades para as vossas crianças, e curraes para as vossas ovelhas; e fazei o que saiu da vossa bocca.
texts.num.32.25: Então fallaram os filhos de Gad, e os filhos de Ruben a Moysés, dizendo: Como ordena meu senhor, assim farão teus servos.
texts.num.32.26: As nossas crianças, as nossas mulheres, a nossa fazenda, e todos os nossos animaes estarão ahi nas cidades de Gilead.
texts.num.32.27: Mas os teus servos passarão, cada um armado para pelejar para a guerra, perante o Senhor, como tem dito meu senhor.
texts.num.32.28: Então Moysés deu ordem ácêrca d’elles a Eleazar, o sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Nun, e aos Cabeças das casas dos paes das tribus dos filhos d’Israel;
texts.num.32.29: E disse-lhes Moysés: Se os filhos de Gad, e os filhos de Ruben passarem comvosco o Jordão, armado cada um para a guerra perante o Senhor; e a terra estiver subjugada diante de vós, em possessão lhes dareis a terra de Gilead;
texts.num.32.30: Porém se não passarem, armados, comvosco, então se porão por possuidores no meio de vós na terra de Canaan.
texts.num.32.31: E responderam os filhos de Gad e os filhos de Ruben, dizendo: O que o Senhor fallou a teus servos, isso faremos.
texts.num.32.32: Nós passaremos, armados, perante o Senhor á terra de Canaan, e teremos a possessão de nossa herança d’áquem do Jordão.
texts.num.32.33: Assim deu-lhes Moysés, aos filhos de Gad, e aos filhos de Ruben, e á meia tribu de Manasseh, filho de José, o reino de Sehon, rei dos amorrheos, e o reino d’Og, rei de Basan: a terra com as suas cidades nos seus termos, as cidades do seu contorno.
texts.num.32.34: E os filhos de Gad edificaram a Dibon, e Ataroth, e Aroer;
texts.num.32.35: E Atroth-sophan, e Jaezer, e Jogbeha;
texts.num.32.36: E Beth-nimra, e Bethharan, cidades fortes; e curraes d’ovelhas.
texts.num.32.37: E os filhos de Ruben edificaram a Hesbon, e Eleal, as e Quiriathaim;
texts.num.32.38: E Nebo, e Baal-meon, mudando-lhes o nome, e Sibma: e os nomes das cidades que edificaram chamaram por outros nomes.
texts.num.32.39: E os filhos de Machir, filho de Manasseh, foram-se para Gilead, e a tomaram: e d’aquella possessão lançaram os amorrheos, que estavam n’ella.
texts.num.32.40: Assim Moysés deu Gilead a Machir, filho de Manasseh, o qual habitou n’ella.
texts.num.32.41: E foi-se Jair, filho de Manasseh, e tomou as suas aldeias; e chamou-as Havot-jair.
texts.num.32.42: E foi-se Nobah, e tomou a Quenath com as suas aldeias; e chamou-a Nobah, segundo o seu nome.
texts.num.33.1: Estas são as jornadas dos filhos d’Israel, que sairam da terra do Egypto, segundo os seus exercitos, pela mão de Moysés e Aarão.
texts.num.33.2: E escreveu Moysés as suas saidas, segundo as suas partidas, conforme ao mandado do Senhor: e estas são as suas jornadas segundo as suas saidas.
texts.num.33.3: Partiram pois de Rahmeses no mez primeiro, no dia quinze do primeiro mez; o seguinte dia da paschoa sairam os filhos de Israel por alta mão aos olhos de todos os egypcios,
texts.num.33.4: Enterrando os egypcios os que o Senhor tinha ferido entre elles, a todo o primogenito, e havendo o Senhor executado os seus juizos nos seus deuses.
texts.num.33.5: Partidos pois os filhos de Israel de Rahmeses, acamparam-se em Succoth.
texts.num.33.6: E partiram de Succoth, e acamparam-se em Etham, que está no fim do deserto.
texts.num.33.7: E partiram d’Etham, e viraram-se a Pi-hahiroth, que está defronte de Baal-zephon, e acamparam-se diante de Migdol.
texts.num.33.8: E partiram de Hahiroth, e passaram pelo meio do mar ao deserto, e andaram caminho de tres dias no deserto de Etham, e acamparam-se em Marah.
texts.num.33.9: E partiram de Marah, e vieram a Elim, e em Elim havia doze fontes de aguas, e setenta palmeiras, e acamparam-se ali.
texts.num.33.10: E partiram d’Elim, e acamparam-se junto ao Mar Vermelho.
texts.num.33.11: E partiram do Mar Vermelho, e acamparam-se no deserto de Sin.
texts.num.33.12: E partiram do deserto de Sin, e acamparam-se em Dophka.
texts.num.33.13: E partiram de Dophka, e acamparam-se em Alus.
texts.num.33.14: E partiram d’Alus, e acamparam-se em Raphidim; porém não havia ali agua, para que o povo bebesse.
texts.num.33.15: Partiram pois de Raphidim, e acamparam-se no deserto de Sinai.
texts.num.33.16: E partiram do deserto de Sinai, e acamparam-se em Quibroth-taava.
texts.num.33.17: E partiram de Quibroth-taava, e acamparam-se em Hazeroth.
texts.num.33.18: E partiram de Hazeroth, e acamparam-se em Rithma.
texts.num.33.19: E partiram de Rithma, e acamparam-se em Rimmon-parez.
texts.num.33.20: E partiram de Rimmon-perez, e acamparam-se em Libna.
texts.num.33.21: E partiram de Libna, e acamparam-se em Rissa.
texts.num.33.22: E partiram de Rissa, e acamparam-se em Kehelatha.
texts.num.33.23: E partiram de Kehelatha, e acamparam-se no monte de Sapher.
texts.num.33.24: E partiram do monte de Sapher, e acamparam-se em Harada.
texts.num.33.25: E partiram de Harada, e acamparam-se em Magheloth.
texts.num.33.26: E partiram de Magheloth, e acamparam-se em Tachath.
texts.num.33.27: E partiram de Tachath, e acamparam-se em Tarah.
texts.num.33.28: E partiram de Tarah, e acamparam-se em Mithka.
texts.num.33.29: E partiram de Mithka, e acamparam-se em Hasmona.
texts.num.33.30: E partiram de Hasmona, e acamparam-se em Moseroth.
texts.num.33.31: E partiram de Moseroth, e acamparam-se em Bene-jaakan.
texts.num.33.32: E partiram de Bene-jaakan, e acamparam-se em Hor-hagidgad.
texts.num.33.33: E partiram de Hor-hagidgad, e acamparam-se em Jothbatha.
texts.num.33.34: E partiram de Jothbatha, e acamparam-se em Abrona.
texts.num.33.35: E partiram d’Abrona, e acamparam-se em Ezion-geber.
texts.num.33.36: E partiram d’Ezion-geber, e acamparam-se no deserto de Zin, que é Cades.
texts.num.33.37: E partiram de Cades, e acamparam-se no monte de Hor, no fim da terra d’Edom.
texts.num.33.38: Então Aarão , o sacerdote, subiu ao monte de Hor, conforme ao mandado do Senhor; e morreu ali no quinto mez do anno quadragesimo da saida dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egypto, no primeiro dia do mez.
texts.num.33.39: E era Aarão d’edade de cento e vinte e tres annos, quando morreu no monte de Hor.
texts.num.33.40: E ouviu o cananeo, rei de Harad, que habitava o sul na terra de Canaan, que chegavam os filhos d’Israel.
texts.num.33.41: E partiram do monte de Hor, e acamparam-se em Zalmona.
texts.num.33.42: E partiram de Zalmona, e acamparam-se em Phunon.
texts.num.33.43: E partiram de Phunon, e acamparam-se em Oboth.
texts.num.33.44: E partiram d’Oboth, e acamparam-se nos outeirinhos de Abarim, no termo de Moab.
texts.num.33.45: E partiram dos outeirinhos d’Abarim, e acamparam-se em Dibon-gad.
texts.num.33.46: E partiram de Dibon-gad, e acamparam-se em Almon-diblathaim.
texts.num.33.47: E partiram d’Almon-diblathaim, e acamparam-se nos montes, d’Abarim, defronte de Nebo.
texts.num.33.48: E partiram dos montes de Abarim, e acamparam-se nas campinas dos moabitas, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.
texts.num.33.49: E acamparam-se junto ao Jordão, desde Beth-jesimoth até Abel-sittim, nas campinas dos moabitas.
texts.num.33.50: E fallou o Senhor a Moysés, nas campinas dos moabitas, junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:
texts.num.33.51: Falla aos filhos d’Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes passado ; o Jordão para a terra de Canaan,
texts.num.33.52: Lançareis fóra todos os moradores da terra diante de vós, e destruireis todas as suas pinturas: tambem destruireis todas as suas imagens de fundição, e desfareis todos os seus altos;
texts.num.33.53: E tomareis a terra em possessão, e n’ella habitareis: porquanto vos tenho dado esta terra, para possuil-a.
texts.num.33.54: E por sortes herdareis a terra segundo as vossas familias; aos muitos a herança multiplicareis, e aos poucos a herança diminuireis; onde a sorte sair a alguem, ali a terá: segundo as tribus de vossos paes tomareis as heranças.
texts.num.33.55: Mas se não lançardes fóra os moradores da terra de diante de vós, então os que deixardes ficar d’elles vos serão por espinhos nos vossos olhos, e por aguilhões nas vossas ilhargas, e apertar-vos-hão na terra em que habitardes.
texts.num.33.56: E será que farei a vós como pensei fazer-lhes a elles.
texts.num.34.1: Fallou mais o Senhor a Moysés, dizendo:
texts.num.34.2: Dá ordem aos filhos d’Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando entrardes na terra de Canaan, esta ha de ser a terra que vos cairá em herança: a terra de Canaan, segundo os seus termos.
texts.num.34.3: A banda do sul vos será desde o deserto de Zin até aos termos de Edom; e o termo do sul vos será desde a extremidade do mar salgado para a banda do oriente,
texts.num.34.4: E este termo vos irá rodeando do sul para a subida de Acrabbim, e passará até Zin; e as suas saidas serão do sul a Cades-barnea; e sairá a Hazar-addar, e passará a Azmon:
texts.num.34.5: Rodeará mais este termo de Azmon até ao rio do Egypto: e as suas saidas serão para a banda do mar.
texts.num.34.6: Ácerca do termo do occidente, o mar grande vos será por termo: este vos será o termo do occidente.
texts.num.34.7: E este vos será o termo do norte: desde o mar grande marcareis até ao monte de Hor.
texts.num.34.8: Desde o monte de Hor marcareis até á entrada de Hamath: e as saidas d’este termo serão até Zedad.
texts.num.34.9: E este termo sairá até Ziphron, e as suas saidas serão em Hazar-enan: este vos será o termo do norte.
texts.num.34.10: E por termo da banda do oriente vos marcareis de Hazar-enan até Sepham.
texts.num.34.11: E este termo descerá desde Sepham até Ribla, para a banda do oriente de Ain: depois descerá este termo, e irá ao longo da borda do mar de Cinnereth para a banda do oriente.
texts.num.34.12: Descerá tambem este termo ao longo do Jordão, e as suas saidas serão no mar salgado: esta vos será a terra, segundo os seus termos em roda.
texts.num.34.13: E Moysés deu ordem aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Esta é a terra que tomareis em sorte por herança, a qual o Senhor mandou dar ás nove tribus e á meia tribu.
texts.num.34.14: Porque a tribu dos filhos dos rubenitas, segundo a casa de seus paes, e a tribu dos filhos dos gaditas, segundo a casa de seus paes, já receberam; tambem a meia tribu de Manasseh recebeu a sua herança.
texts.num.34.15: Já duas tribus e meia tribu receberam a sua herança d’aquem do Jordão de Jericó, da banda do oriente ao nascente.
texts.num.34.16: Fallou mais o Senhor a Moysés, dizendo:
texts.num.34.17: Estes são os nomes dos homens que vos repartirão a terra por herança: Eleazar, o sacerdote, e Josué, o filho de Nun.
texts.num.34.18: Tomareis mais de cada tribu um principe, para repartir a terra em herança.
texts.num.34.19: E estes são os nomes dos homens: Da tribu de Judah, Caleb, filho de Jefoné;
texts.num.34.20: E, da tribu dos filhos de Simeão, Samuel, filho de Ammihud;
texts.num.34.21: Da tribu de Benjamin, Elidad, filho de Chislon;
texts.num.34.22: E, da tribu dos filhos de Dan, o principe Buci, filho de Jogli;
texts.num.34.23: Dos filhos de José, da tribu dos filhos de Manasseh, o principe Hanniel, filho de Ephod;
texts.num.34.24: E, da tribu dos filhos de Ephraim, o principe Quemuel, filho de Siphtan;
texts.num.34.25: E, da tribu dos filhos de Zebulon, o principe Elizaphan, filho de Parnah;
texts.num.34.26: E, da tribu dos filhos de Issacar, o principe Paltiel, filho de Assan;
texts.num.34.27: E, da tribu dos filhos de Aser, o principe Ahihud, filho de Selomi;
texts.num.34.28: E, da tribu dos filhos de Naphtali, o principe Pedael, filho de Ammihud.
texts.num.34.29: Estes são aquelles a quem o Senhor ordenou, que repartissem as heranças aos filhos de Israel na terra de Canaan.
texts.num.35.1: E fallou o Senhor a Moysés nas campinas dos moabitas, junto ao Jordão de Jericó, dizendo:
texts.num.35.2: Dá ordem aos filhos de Israel que, da herança da sua possessão, dêem cidades aos levitas, em que habitem: e tambem aos levitas dareis arrabaldes ao redor d’ellas.
texts.num.35.3: E terão estas cidades para habitalas: porém os seus arrabaldes serão para as suas bestas, e para a sua fazenda, e para todos os seus animaes.
texts.num.35.4: E os arrabaldes das cidades que dareis aos levitas, desde o muro da cidade e para fóra, serão de mil covados em redor.
texts.num.35.5: E de fóra da cidade, da banda do oriente, medireis dois mil covados, e da banda do sul dois mil covados, e da banda do occidente dois mil covados, e da banda do norte dois mil covados, e a cidade no meio: isto terão por arrabaldes das cidades.
texts.num.35.6: Das cidades pois que dareis aos levitas haverá seis cidades de refugio, as quaes dareis para que o homicida ali se acolha: e, além d’estas, lhes dareis quarenta e duas cidades.
texts.num.35.7: Todas as cidades que dareis aos levitas serão quarenta e oito cidades, juntamente com os seus arrabaldes.
texts.num.35.8: E as cidades que derdes da herança dos filhos de Israel, do que tiver muito tomareis muito, e do que tiver pouco tomareis pouco: cada um dará das suas cidades aos levitas, segundo a sua herança que herdar.
texts.num.35.9: Fallou mais o Senhor a Moysés, dizendo:
texts.num.35.10: Falla aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando passardes o Jordão á terra de Canaan,
texts.num.35.11: Fazei com que vos estejam á mão cidades que vos sirvam de cidades de refugio, para que ali se acolha o homicida que ferir a alguma alma por erro.
texts.num.35.12: E estas cidades vos serão por refugio do vingador do sangue: para que o homicida não morra, até que esteja perante a congregação no juizo.
texts.num.35.13: E das cidades que derdes haverá seis cidades de refugio para vós.
texts.num.35.14: Tres d’estas cidades dareis d’áquem do Jordão, e tres d’estas cidades dareis na terra de Canaan: cidades de refugio serão.
texts.num.35.15: Serão por refugio estas seis cidades para os filhos de Israel, e para o estrangeiro, e para o que se hospedar no meio d’elles, para que ali se acolha aquelle que ferir a alguma alma por erro.
texts.num.35.16: Porém, se a ferir com instrumento de ferro, e morrer, homicida é: certamente o homicida morrerá.
texts.num.35.17: Ou, se lhe atirar uma pedrada, de que possa morrer, e ella morrer, homicida é: certamente o homicida morrerá.
texts.num.35.18: Ou, se a ferir com instrumento de pau que tiver na mão, de que possa morrer, e ella morrer, homicida é: certamente morrerá o homicida.
texts.num.35.19: O vingador do sangue matará o homicida: encontrando-o, matal-o-ha.
texts.num.35.20: Se tambem a empurrar com odio, ou com intento lançar contra ella alguma coisa, e morrer;
texts.num.35.21: Ou por inimizade a ferir com a sua mão, e morrer, certamente morrerá o feridor; homicida é: o vingador do sangue, encontrando o homicida, o matará.
texts.num.35.22: Porém, se a empurrar de improviso, sem inimizade, ou contra ella lançar algum instrumento sem designio;
texts.num.35.23: Ou, sobre ella fizer cair alguma pedra sem o ver, de que possa morrer, e ella morrer, e elle não era seu inimigo nem procurava o seu mal;
texts.num.35.24: Então a congregação julgará entre o feridor e entre o vingador do sangue, segundo estas leis.
texts.num.35.25: E a congregação livrará o homicida da mão do vingador do sangue, e a congregação o fará voltar á cidade do seu refugio, onde se tinha acolhido: e ali ficará até á morte do summo sacerdote, a quem ungiram com o sancto oleo.
texts.num.35.26: Porém, se de alguma maneira o homicida sair dos termos da cidade do seu refugio, onde se tinha acolhido,
texts.num.35.27: E o vingador do sangue o achar fóra dos termos da cidade do seu refugio, se o vingador do sangue matar o homicida, não será culpado do sangue.
texts.num.35.28: Pois deve ficar na cidade do seu refugio, até á morte do summo sacerdote: mas, depois da morte do summo sacerdote, o homicida voltará á terra da sua possessão.
texts.num.35.29: E estas coisas vos serão por estatuto de direito a vossas gerações, em todas as vossas habitações.
texts.num.35.30: Todo aquelle que ferir a alguma pessoa, conforme ao dito das testemunhas, matarão o homicida: mas uma só testemunha não testemunhará contra algum, para que morra.
texts.num.35.31: E não tomareis expiação pela vida o homicida, que culpado está de morte: antes certamente morrerá.
texts.num.35.32: Tambem não tomareis expiação por aquelle que se acolher á cidade do seu refugio, para tornar a habitar na terra, até a morte do summo sacerdote.
texts.num.35.33: Assim não profanareis a terra em que estaes; porque o sangue faz profanar a terra: e nenhuma expiação se fará pela terra por causa do sangue que se derramar n’ella, senão com o sangue d’aquelle que o derramou.
texts.num.35.34: Não contaminareis pois a terra na qual vós habitareis, no meio da qual eu habitarei: pois eu, o Senhor, habito no meio dos filhos d’Israel.
texts.num.36.1: E chegaram os cabeças dos paes da geração dos filhos de Gilead, filho de Machir, filho de Manasseh, das familias dos filhos de José, e fallaram diante de Moysés, e diante dos maioraes, cabeças dos paes dos filhos d’Israel,
texts.num.36.2: E disseram: O Senhor mandou dar esta terra a meu senhor por sorte, por herança aos filhos d’Israel: e a meu senhor foi ordenado pelo Senhor, que a herança do nosso irmão Selofad se désse a suas filhas.
texts.num.36.3: E, casando-se ellas com algum dos filhos das outras tribus dos filhos d’Israel, então a sua herança seria diminuida da herança de nossos paes, e accrescentada á herança da tribu de quem forem: assim se tiraria da sorte da nossa herança.
texts.num.36.4: Vindo tambem o anno do jubileo dos filhos d’Israel, a sua herança se accrescentaria á herança da tribu d’aquelles com que se casarem: assim a sua herança será tirada da herança da tribu de nossos paes.
texts.num.36.5: Então Moysés deu ordem aos filhos d’Israel, segundo o mandado do Senhor, dizendo: A tribu dos filhos de José falla bem.
texts.num.36.6: Esta é a palavra que o Senhor mandou ácerca das filhas de Selofad, dizendo: Sejam por mulheres a quem bem parecer aos seus olhos, comtanto que se casem na familia da tribu de seu pae.
texts.num.36.7: Assim a herança dos filhos d’Israel não passará de tribu em tribu: pois os filhos d’Israel se chegarão cada um á herança da tribu de seus paes.
texts.num.36.8: E qualquer filha que herdar alguma herança das tribus dos filhos d’Israel se casará com alguem da geração da tribu de seu pae: para que os filhos de Israel possuam cada, um a herança de seus paes.
texts.num.36.9: Assim a herança não passará d’uma tribu a outra: pois as tribus dos filhos d’Israel se chegarão cada uma á sua herança.
texts.num.36.10: Como o Senhor ordenara a Moysés, assim fizeram as filhas de Selofad.
texts.num.36.11: Pois Machla, Thirsa, e Hogla, e Milca, e Noha, filhas de Selofad, se casaram com os filhos de seus tios.
texts.num.36.12: Das familias dos de Manasseh, filho de José, ellas foram mulheres: assim a sua herança ficou á tribu da familia de seu pae.
texts.num.36.13: Estes são os mandamentos e os juizos que mandou o Senhor pela mão de Moysés aos filhos de Israel nas campinas dos moabitas, junto ao Jordão de Jericó.

texts.num.1.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
texts.num.1.2: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their poll:
texts.num.1.3: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel; thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
texts.num.1.4: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
texts.num.1.5: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: Of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
texts.num.1.6: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
texts.num.1.7: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
texts.num.1.8: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
texts.num.1.9: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
texts.num.1.10: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
texts.num.1.11: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
texts.num.1.12: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
texts.num.1.13: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
texts.num.1.14: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
texts.num.1.15: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
texts.num.1.16: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
texts.num.1.17: And Moses and Aaron took these men who are expressed by their names:
texts.num.1.18: And they assembled all the congregation on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
texts.num.1.19: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.1.20: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.21: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.1.22: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.23: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
texts.num.1.24: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.25: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
texts.num.1.26: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.27: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were seventy and four thousand and six hundred.
texts.num.1.28: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.29: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.30: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.31: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.32: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.33: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.1.34: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.35: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.1.36: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.37: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.38: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.39: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were sixty and two thousand and seven hundred.
texts.num.1.40: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.41: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.1.42: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
texts.num.1.43: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.44: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
texts.num.1.45: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
texts.num.1.46: Even all they that were numbered, were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
texts.num.1.47: But the Levites, after the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered among them.
texts.num.1.48: For the LORD had spoken to Moses, saying,
texts.num.1.49: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
texts.num.1.50: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all its vessels, and they shall minister to it, and shall encamp around the tabernacle.
texts.num.1.51: And when the tabernacle moveth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
texts.num.1.52: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
texts.num.1.53: But the Levites shall pitch around the tabernacle of testimony; that there may be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
texts.num.1.54: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
texts.num.2.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.num.2.2: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
texts.num.2.3: And on the east side towards the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
texts.num.2.4: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were seventy and four thousand and six hundred.
texts.num.2.5: And those that shall pitch next to him, shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
texts.num.2.6: And his host, and those that were numbered of it, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.7: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
texts.num.2.8: And his host, and those that were numbered of it, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.9: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were a hundred thousand and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred throughout their armies: these shall first move forward.
texts.num.2.10: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
texts.num.2.11: And his host, and those that were numbered of it were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.2.12: And those who pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
texts.num.2.13: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
texts.num.2.14: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
texts.num.2.15: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
texts.num.2.16: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were a hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies: and they shall move forward in the second rank.
texts.num.2.17: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall move forward with the camp of the Levites, in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they move forward, every man in his place by their standards.
texts.num.2.18: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim, according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
texts.num.2.19: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.2.20: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
texts.num.2.21: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.2.22: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
texts.num.2.23: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.24: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim, were a hundred thousand and eight thousand and a hundred, throughout their armies: and they shall go forward in the third rank.
texts.num.2.25: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
texts.num.2.26: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were sixty and two thousand and seven hundred.
texts.num.2.27: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
texts.num.2.28: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.2.29: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
texts.num.2.30: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.31: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred: they shall go hindmost with their standards.
texts.num.2.32: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers. All those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts, were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
texts.num.2.33: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.2.34: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they moved forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
texts.num.3.1: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses, in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in mount Sinai.
texts.num.3.2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the first-born, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
texts.num.3.3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
texts.num.3.4: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
texts.num.3.5: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.6: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
texts.num.3.7: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
texts.num.3.8: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
texts.num.3.9: And thou shalt give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given to him out of the children of Israel.
texts.num.3.10: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
texts.num.3.11: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.12: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel, instead of all the first-born that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
texts.num.3.13: Because all the first-born are mine; for on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt, I hallowed to me all the first-born in Israel, both man and beast: mine they shall be: I am the LORD.
texts.num.3.14: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
texts.num.3.15: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
texts.num.3.16: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
texts.num.3.17: And these were the sons of Levi, by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
texts.num.3.18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
texts.num.3.19: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
texts.num.3.20: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi: these are the families of the Levites, according to the house of their fathers.
texts.num.3.21: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
texts.num.3.22: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them, were seven thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.3.23: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
texts.num.3.24: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
texts.num.3.25: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
texts.num.3.26: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it, for all the service of it.
texts.num.3.27: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
texts.num.3.28: In the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.29: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
texts.num.3.30: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
texts.num.3.31: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the hanging, and all the service of it.
texts.num.3.32: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.33: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
texts.num.3.34: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.3.35: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
texts.num.3.36: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all its vessels, and all that serveth to it.
texts.num.3.37: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
texts.num.3.38: But those that encamp before the tabernacle towards the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward shall be Moses and Aaron, and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary, for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
texts.num.3.39: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
texts.num.3.40: And the LORD said to Moses, number all the first-born of the males of the children of Israel, from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
texts.num.3.41: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites, instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
texts.num.3.42: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the first-born among the children of Israel.
texts.num.3.43: And all the first-born males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and seventy and three.
texts.num.3.44: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.45: Take the Levites instead of all the first-born among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
texts.num.3.46: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and seventy and three, of the first-born of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites:
texts.num.3.47: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: the shekel is twenty gerahs.
texts.num.3.48: And thou shalt give to Aaron and to his sons the money, with which the odd number of them is to be redeemed.
texts.num.3.49: And Moses took the redemption-money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
texts.num.3.50: Of the first-born of the children of Israel he took the money; a thousand three hundred and sixty and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.51: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed to Aaron, and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.4.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.num.4.2: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers;
texts.num.4.3: From thirty years old and upward, even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.num.4.4: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things.
texts.num.4.5: And when the camp moveth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
texts.num.4.6: And shall put on it the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staffs of it.
texts.num.4.7: And upon the table of show-bread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put on it the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover with: and the continual bread shall be upon it.
texts.num.4.8: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staffs of it.
texts.num.4.9: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its snuff-dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it:
texts.num.4.10: And they shall put it, and all its vessels, within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
texts.num.4.11: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to it its staffs.
texts.num.4.12: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar.
texts.num.4.13: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth upon it:
texts.num.4.14: And they shall put upon it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, even the censers, the flesh-hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to it its staffs.
texts.num.4.15: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to move forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.num.4.16: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertain the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat-offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, in the sanctuary, and in its vessels.
texts.num.4.17: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.num.4.18: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
texts.num.4.19: But thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
texts.num.4.20: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
texts.num.4.21: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.4.22: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the house of their fathers, by their families;
texts.num.4.23: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.num.4.24: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
texts.num.4.25: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, its covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
texts.num.4.26: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
texts.num.4.27: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint to them in charge all their burdens.
texts.num.4.28: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
texts.num.4.29: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
texts.num.4.30: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.num.4.31: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,
texts.num.4.32: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
texts.num.4.33: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
texts.num.4.34: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.35: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
texts.num.4.36: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
texts.num.4.37: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
texts.num.4.38: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.39: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
texts.num.4.40: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
texts.num.4.41: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of the LORD.
texts.num.4.42: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.43: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
texts.num.4.44: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.4.45: These are those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
texts.num.4.46: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.47: From thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
texts.num.4.48: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and eighty.
texts.num.4.49: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.5.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.5.2: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whoever is defiled by the dead:
texts.num.5.3: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst of which I dwell.
texts.num.5.4: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.
texts.num.5.5: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.5.6: Speak to the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person shall be guilty;
texts.num.5.7: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal of it, and add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him against whom he hath trespassed.
texts.num.5.8: But if the man shall have no kinsman to recompense the trespass to, let the trespass be recompensed to the LORD, even to the priest; besides the ram of the atonement, by which an atonement shall be made for him.
texts.num.5.9: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring to the priest, shall be his.
texts.num.5.10: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatever any man giveth to the priest, it shall be his.
texts.num.5.11: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.5.12: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, If any man's wife shall go astray, and commit a trespass against him,
texts.num.5.13: And a man shall lie with her carnally, and it shall be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
texts.num.5.14: And the spirit of jealousy shall come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy shall come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
texts.num.5.15: Then shall the man bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley-meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense upon it; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
texts.num.5.16: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
texts.num.5.17: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
texts.num.5.18: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy-offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
texts.num.5.19: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say to the woman, If no man hath lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
texts.num.5.20: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou art defiled, and some man hath lain with thee besides thy husband:
texts.num.5.21: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say to the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to perish, and thy belly to swell;
texts.num.5.22: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to perish. And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
texts.num.5.23: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
texts.num.5.24: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
texts.num.5.25: Then the priest shall take the jealousy-offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
texts.num.5.26: And the priest shall take a handful of the offering, even the memorial of it, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
texts.num.5.27: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she is defiled, and hath done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall perish: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
texts.num.5.28: And if the woman is not defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
texts.num.5.29: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth astray to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
texts.num.5.30: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he is jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
texts.num.5.31: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
texts.num.6.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.6.2: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves to the LORD.
texts.num.6.3: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
texts.num.6.4: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine-tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
texts.num.6.5: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days shall be fulfilled, in which he separateth himself to the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
texts.num.6.6: All the days that he separateth himself to the LORD, he shall come at no dead body.
texts.num.6.7: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
texts.num.6.8: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.
texts.num.6.9: And if any man shall die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
texts.num.6.10: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
texts.num.6.11: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
texts.num.6.12: And he shall consecrate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass-offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
texts.num.6.13: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
texts.num.6.14: And he shall offer his offering to the LORD, one he-lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt-offering, and one ewe-lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin-offering, and one ram without blemish for peace-offerings,
texts.num.6.15: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat-offering and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.6.16: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin-offering, and his burnt-offering:
texts.num.6.17: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace-offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat-offering, and his drink-offering.
texts.num.6.18: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace-offerings.
texts.num.6.19: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
texts.num.6.20: And the priest shall wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave-breast, and heave-shoulder: and after that, the Nazarite may drink wine.
texts.num.6.21: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, besides that which his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
texts.num.6.22: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.6.23: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying to them,
texts.num.6.24: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
texts.num.6.25: The LORD make his face to shine upon thee, and be gracious to thee:
texts.num.6.26: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
texts.num.6.27: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.
texts.num.7.1: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all its instruments, both the altar and all its vessels, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
texts.num.7.2: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
texts.num.7.3: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
texts.num.7.4: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.7.5: Take it of them, that they may be to perform the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.
texts.num.7.6: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
texts.num.7.7: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
texts.num.7.8: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
texts.num.7.9: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging to them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
texts.num.7.10: And the princes offered for dedicating the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
texts.num.7.11: And the LORD said to Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
texts.num.7.12: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
texts.num.7.13: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:
texts.num.7.14: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
texts.num.7.15: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt-offering:
texts.num.7.16: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.17: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year; this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
texts.num.7.18: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, offered.
texts.num.7.19: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:
texts.num.7.20: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
texts.num.7.21: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt-offering:
texts.num.7.22: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.23: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
texts.num.7.24: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, offered:
texts.num.7.25: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.28: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.29: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
texts.num.7.30: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, offered:
texts.num.7.31: His offering was one silver charger, of the weight of a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.34: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.35: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.
texts.num.7.36: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, offered:
texts.num.7.37: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.41: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
texts.num.7.42: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:
texts.num.7.43: His offering was one silver charger, of the weight of a hundred and thirty shekels, a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.48: On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:
texts.num.7.49: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.52: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.53: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.
texts.num.7.54: On the eighth day offered Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh:
texts.num.7.55: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.59: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
texts.num.7.60: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered:
texts.num.7.61: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.66: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, offered:
texts.num.7.67: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.71: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
texts.num.7.72: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, offered:
texts.num.7.73: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:

texts.num.7.77: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
texts.num.7.78: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
texts.num.7.79: His offering was one silver charger, the weight of which was a hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering:
texts.num.7.80: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
texts.num.7.81: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt-offering:
texts.num.7.82: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.83: And for a sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
texts.num.7.84: This was the dedication of the altar (in the day when it was anointed) by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
texts.num.7.85: Each charger of silver weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
texts.num.7.86: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was a hundred and twenty shekels.
texts.num.7.87: All the oxen for the burnt-offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat-offering: and the kids of the goats for sin-offering, twelve.
texts.num.7.88: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace-offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he-goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.
texts.num.7.89: And when Moses had entered into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking to him from off the mercy-seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.
texts.num.8.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.8.2: Speak to Aaron, and say to him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
texts.num.8.3: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps of it over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.8.4: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, to its shaft, to the flowers of it, was beaten work: according to the pattern which the LORD had showed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
texts.num.8.5: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.8.6: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
texts.num.8.7: And thus shalt thou do to them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
texts.num.8.8: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat-offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin-offering.
texts.num.8.9: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt convene the whole assembly of the children of Israel:
texts.num.8.10: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
texts.num.8.11: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
texts.num.8.12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, to the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
texts.num.8.13: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering to the LORD.
texts.num.8.14: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
texts.num.8.15: And after that shall the Levites go in to perform the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
texts.num.8.16: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the first-born of all the children of Israel, have I taken them to me.
texts.num.8.17: For all the first born of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
texts.num.8.18: And I have taken the Levites for all the first-born of the children of Israel.
texts.num.8.19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there may be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh to the sanctuary.
texts.num.8.20: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel to them.
texts.num.8.21: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
texts.num.8.22: And after that went the Levites in to perform their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they to them.
texts.num.8.23: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.8.24: This is it that belongeth to the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
texts.num.8.25: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service of it, and shall serve no more:
texts.num.8.26: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do to the Levites concerning their charge.
texts.num.9.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
texts.num.9.2: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at its appointed season.
texts.num.9.3: In the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, ye shall keep it in its appointed season: according to all its rites, and according to all its ceremonies, shall ye keep it.
texts.num.9.4: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
texts.num.9.5: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at evening in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
texts.num.9.6: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
texts.num.9.7: And those men said to him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: why are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?
texts.num.9.8: And Moses said to them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
texts.num.9.9: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.9.10: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover to the LORD.
texts.num.9.11: The fourteenth day of the second month at evening, they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
texts.num.9.12: They shall leave none of it to the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
texts.num.9.13: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
texts.num.9.14: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover to the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner of it, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
texts.num.9.15: And on the day that the tabernacle was erected the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at evening there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
texts.num.9.16: So it was always; the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
texts.num.9.17: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
texts.num.9.18: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
texts.num.9.19: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
texts.num.9.20: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
texts.num.9.21: And so it was, when the cloud abode from evening to the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
texts.num.9.22: Or whether it was two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining upon it, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
texts.num.9.23: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
texts.num.10.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.10.2: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them; that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
texts.num.10.3: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
texts.num.10.4: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, who are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall assemble themselves to thee.
texts.num.10.5: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
texts.num.10.6: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
texts.num.10.7: But when the congregation is to be convened, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
texts.num.10.8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
