texts.num.26.20: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharezites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
texts.num.26.21: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
texts.num.26.22: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, seventy six thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.26.23: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
texts.num.26.24: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
texts.num.26.25: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, sixty four thousand and three hundred.
texts.num.26.26: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
texts.num.26.27: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, sixty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.26.28: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
texts.num.26.29: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
texts.num.26.30: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
texts.num.26.31: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
texts.num.26.32: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
texts.num.26.33: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
texts.num.26.34: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
texts.num.26.35: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
texts.num.26.36: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
texts.num.26.37: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
texts.num.26.38: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
texts.num.26.39: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
texts.num.26.40: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
texts.num.26.41: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
texts.num.26.42: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
texts.num.26.43: All the families of the Shuhamites according to those that were numbered of them were sixty and four thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.26.44: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
texts.num.26.45: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
texts.num.26.46: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
texts.num.26.47: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.26.48: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
texts.num.26.49: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
texts.num.26.50: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.26.51: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
texts.num.26.52: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.26.53: To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance, according to the number of names.
texts.num.26.54: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given, according to those that were numbered of him.
texts.num.26.55: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
texts.num.26.56: According to the lot shall the possession of it be divided between many and few.
texts.num.26.57: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
texts.num.26.58: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
texts.num.26.59: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bore to Levi in Egypt: and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
texts.num.26.60: And to Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
texts.num.26.61: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
texts.num.26.62: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
texts.num.26.63: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
texts.num.26.64: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.26.65: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
texts.num.27.1: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
texts.num.27.2: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes, and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
texts.num.27.3: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that assembled themselves against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
texts.num.27.4: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give to us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
texts.num.27.5: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
texts.num.27.6: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.27.7: The daughters of Zelophehad speak what is right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
texts.num.27.8: And thou shalt speak to the children of Israel, saying, If a man shall die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
texts.num.27.9: And if he shall have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance to his brethren.
texts.num.27.10: And if he shall have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance to his father's brethren.
texts.num.27.11: And if his father shall have no brethren, then ye shall give inheritance to his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be to the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.27.12: And the LORD said to Moses, Ascend this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
texts.num.27.13: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered to thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
texts.num.27.14: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
texts.num.27.15: And Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
texts.num.27.16: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation.
texts.num.27.17: Who may go out before them, and who may go in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
texts.num.27.18: And the LORD said to Moses, Take to thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thy hand upon him;
texts.num.27.19: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation: and give him a charge in their sight.
texts.num.27.20: And thou shalt put some of thy honor upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
texts.num.27.21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
texts.num.27.22: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
texts.num.27.23: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
texts.num.28.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.28.2: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savor to me, shall ye observe to offer to me in their due season.
texts.num.28.3: And thou shalt say to them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer to the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt-offering.
texts.num.28.4: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening.
texts.num.28.5: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat-offering, mingled with a fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.
texts.num.28.6: It is a continual burnt-offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savor, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD.
texts.num.28.7: And the drink-offering of it shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured to the LORD for a drink-offering.
texts.num.28.8: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at evening; as the meat-offering of the morning, and as the drink-offering of it, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD.
texts.num.28.9: And on the sabbath-day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth-parts of flour for a meat-offering, mingled with oil, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.28.10: This is the burnt-offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt-offering, and his drink-offering.
texts.num.28.11: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt-offering to the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
texts.num.28.12: And three tenth-parts of flour for a meat-offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth-parts of flour for a meat-offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
texts.num.28.13: And a several tenth-part of flour mingled with oil for a meat-offering to one lamb, for a burnt-offering of a sweet savor, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD.
texts.num.28.14: And their drink-offering shall be half a hin of wine to a bullock, and the third part of a hin to a ram, and a fourth part of a hin to a lamb: this is the burnt-offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
texts.num.28.15: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering to the LORD shall be offered, besides the continual burnt-offering, and his drink-offering.
texts.num.28.16: And on the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.
texts.num.28.17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
texts.num.28.18: On the first day shall be a holy convocation; in it ye shall do no manner of servile work.
texts.num.28.19: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt-offering to the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be to you without blemish:
texts.num.28.20: And their meat-offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth-parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth-parts for a ram;
texts.num.28.21: A several tenth-part shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
texts.num.28.22: And one goat for a sin-offering, to make an atonement for you.
texts.num.28.23: Ye shall offer these besides the burnt-offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering.
texts.num.28.24: After this manner ye shall offer daily throughout the seven days, the food of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and his drink-offering.
texts.num.28.25: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
texts.num.28.26: Also in the day of the first-fruits, when ye bring a new meat-offering to the LORD, after your weeks are ended, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
texts.num.28.27: But ye shall offer the burnt-offering for a sweet savor to the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
texts.num.28.28: And their meat-offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth-parts to one bullock, two tenth-parts to one ram,
texts.num.28.29: A several tenth part to one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
texts.num.28.30: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
texts.num.28.31: Ye shall offer them besides the continual burnt-offering and his meat-offering (they shall be to you without blemish) and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.1: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets to you.
texts.num.29.2: And ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet savor to the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
texts.num.29.3: And their meat-offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth-parts for a bullock, and two tenth-parts for a ram,
texts.num.29.4: And one tenth-part for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
texts.num.29.5: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering, to make an atonement for you:
texts.num.29.6: Besides the burnt-offering of the month, and his meat-offering, and the daily burnt-offering, and his meat-offering, and their drink-offerings, according to their manner, for a sweet savor, a sacrifice made by fire to the LORD.
texts.num.29.7: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month a holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: in it ye shall not do any work.
texts.num.29.8: But ye shall offer a burnt-offering to the LORD for a sweet savor; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be to you without blemish:
texts.num.29.9: And their meat-offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth-parts to a bullock, and two tenth-parts to one ram,
texts.num.29.10: A several tenth-part for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
texts.num.29.11: One kid of the goats for a sin-offering; besides the sin-offering of atonement, and the continual burnt-offering, and the meat-offering of it, and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days:
texts.num.29.13: And ye shall offer a burnt-offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
texts.num.29.14: And their meat-offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth-parts to every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth-parts to each ram of the two rams,
texts.num.29.15: And a several tenth-part to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
texts.num.29.16: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, his meat-offering, and his drink-offering.
texts.num.29.17: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
texts.num.29.18: And their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
texts.num.29.19: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and its meat-offering, and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.20: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
texts.num.29.21: And their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
texts.num.29.22: And one goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and its meat-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.23: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
texts.num.29.24: Their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner.
texts.num.29.25: And one kid of the goats for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, its meat-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.26: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
texts.num.29.27: And their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
texts.num.29.28: And one goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and its meat-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.29: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
texts.num.29.30: And their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
texts.num.29.31: And one goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, its meat-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.32: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
texts.num.29.33: And their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
texts.num.29.34: And one goat for a sin-offering: besides the continual burnt-offering, its meat-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.35: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: in it ye shall do no servile work.
texts.num.29.36: But ye shall offer a burnt-offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savor to the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
texts.num.29.37: Their meat-offering and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
texts.num.29.38: And one goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, and its meat-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.39: These things ye shall do to the LORD in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your free-will-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your meat-offerings, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.
texts.num.29.40: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.30.1: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
texts.num.30.2: If a man shall vow a vow to the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
texts.num.30.3: If a woman also shall vow a vow to the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
texts.num.30.4: And her father shall hear her vow, and her bond with which she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she hath bound her soul shall stand.
texts.num.30.5: But if her father shall disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows or of her bonds with which she hath bound her soul shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
texts.num.30.6: And if she had a husband when she vowed, or uttered aught from her lips, with which she bound her soul;
texts.num.30.7: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she bound her soul shall stand.
texts.num.30.8: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make of no effect her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, with which she bound her soul: and the LORD shall forgive her.
texts.num.30.9: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, with which they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
texts.num.30.10: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
texts.num.30.11: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.
texts.num.30.12: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
texts.num.30.13: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
texts.num.30.14: But if her husband altogether holds his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
texts.num.30.15: But if he shall any way make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
texts.num.30.16: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
texts.num.31.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.31.2: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered to thy people.
texts.num.31.3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves for the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD on Midian.
texts.num.31.4: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
texts.num.31.5: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
texts.num.31.6: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
texts.num.31.7: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
texts.num.31.8: And they slew the kings of Midian, besides the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
texts.num.31.9: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
texts.num.31.10: And they burnt all their cities in which they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
texts.num.31.11: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
texts.num.31.12: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
texts.num.31.13: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
texts.num.31.14: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, who came from the battle.
texts.num.31.15: And Moses said to them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
texts.num.31.16: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD, in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
texts.num.31.17: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
texts.num.31.18: But all the female children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
texts.num.31.19: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whoever hath killed any person, and whoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
texts.num.31.20: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
texts.num.31.21: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
texts.num.31.22: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
texts.num.31.23: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
texts.num.31.24: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
texts.num.31.25: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.31.26: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
texts.num.31.27: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
texts.num.31.28: And levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
texts.num.31.29: Take it of their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for a heave-offering of the LORD.
texts.num.31.30: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them to the Levites, who keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
texts.num.31.31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.32: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had taken, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
texts.num.31.35: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
texts.num.31.36: And the half which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
texts.num.31.37: And the LORD'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and seventy five.
texts.num.31.38: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was seventy two.
texts.num.31.39: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute was sixty one.
texts.num.31.40: And the persons were sixteen thousand, of which the LORD'S tribute was thirty and two persons.
texts.num.31.41: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD'S heave-offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.42: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
texts.num.31.43: (Now the half that pertained to the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
texts.num.31.44: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
texts.num.31.45: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
texts.num.31.47: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them to the Levites, who kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.48: And the officers who were over thousands of the hosts, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses:
texts.num.31.49: And they said to Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
texts.num.31.50: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath obtained of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, ear-rings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
texts.num.31.51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
texts.num.31.52: And all the gold of the offering that they offered to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
texts.num.31.53: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
texts.num.31.54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands, and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
texts.num.32.1: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for cattle;
texts.num.32.2: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
texts.num.32.3: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
texts.num.32.4: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
texts.num.32.5: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
texts.num.32.6: And Moses said to the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
texts.num.32.7: And why discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
texts.num.32.8: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
texts.num.32.9: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
texts.num.32.10: And the LORD'S anger was kindled the same time, and he swore, saying,
texts.num.32.11: Surely none of the men that came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
texts.num.32.12: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
texts.num.32.13: And the LORD'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the sight of the LORD was consumed.
texts.num.32.14: And behold, ye have risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD towards Israel.
texts.num.32.15: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and he will destroy all this people.
texts.num.32.16: And they came near to him, and said, We will build sheep-folds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
texts.num.32.17: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities, because of the inhabitants of the land.
texts.num.32.18: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
texts.num.32.19: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance hath fallen to us on this side of Jordan eastward.
texts.num.32.20: And Moses said to them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
texts.num.32.21: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
texts.num.32.22: And the land shall be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
texts.num.32.23: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
texts.num.32.24: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
texts.num.32.25: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
texts.num.32.26: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
texts.num.32.27: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
texts.num.32.28: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
texts.num.32.29: And Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed for battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
texts.num.32.30: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
texts.num.32.31: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said to thy servants, so will we do.
texts.num.32.32: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
texts.num.32.33: And Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with its cities in the borders, even the cities of the country around.
texts.num.32.34: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
texts.num.32.35: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
texts.num.32.36: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities: and folds for sheep.
texts.num.32.37: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
texts.num.32.38: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names to the cities which they built.
texts.num.32.39: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite who was in it.
texts.num.32.40: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt in it.
texts.num.32.41: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its small towns, and called them Havoth-jair.
texts.num.32.42: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
texts.num.33.1: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went forth from the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
texts.num.33.2: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
texts.num.33.3: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
texts.num.33.4: For the Egyptians buried all their first-born, whom the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
texts.num.33.5: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
texts.num.33.6: And they departed from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
texts.num.33.7: And they removed from Etham, and turned again to Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.
texts.num.33.8: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
texts.num.33.9: And they removed from Marah, and came to Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm-trees; and they encamped there.
texts.num.33.10: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
texts.num.33.11: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
texts.num.33.12: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
texts.num.33.13: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
texts.num.33.14: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
texts.num.33.15: And they departed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.33.16: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and encamped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
texts.num.33.17: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
texts.num.33.18: And they departed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
texts.num.33.19: And they departed from Rithmah, and encamped at Rimmon-parez.
texts.num.33.20: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and encamped in Libnah.
texts.num.33.21: And they removed from Libnah, and encamped at Rissah.
texts.num.33.22: And they journeyed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
texts.num.33.23: And they went from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shapher.
texts.num.33.24: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
texts.num.33.25: And they removed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
texts.num.33.26: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
texts.num.33.27: And they departed from Tahath, and encamped at Tarah.
texts.num.33.28: And they removed from Tarah, and encamped in Mithcah.
texts.num.33.29: And they went from Mithcah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
texts.num.33.30: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
texts.num.33.31: And they departed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-jaakan.
texts.num.33.32: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
texts.num.33.33: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
texts.num.33.34: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
texts.num.33.35: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
texts.num.33.36: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
texts.num.33.37: And they removed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
texts.num.33.38: And Aaron the priest ascended mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel departed from the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
texts.num.33.39: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
texts.num.33.40: And king Arad the Canaanite who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
texts.num.33.41: And they departed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
texts.num.33.42: And they departed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
texts.num.33.43: And they departed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
texts.num.33.44: And they departed from Oboth, and encamped in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
texts.num.33.45: And they departed from Iim, and encamped in Dibon-gad.
texts.num.33.46: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
texts.num.33.47: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and encamped on the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
texts.num.33.48: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
texts.num.33.49: And they encamped by Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth even to Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
texts.num.33.50: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
texts.num.33.51: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye have passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
texts.num.33.52: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite demolish all their high places:
texts.num.33.53: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell in it; for I have given you the land to possess it.
texts.num.33.54: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
texts.num.33.55: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be prickles in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall harass you in the land in which ye dwell.
texts.num.33.56: Moreover, it shall come to pass, that I shall do to you as I thought to do to them.
texts.num.34.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.34.2: Command the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with its borders.)
texts.num.34.3: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the border of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
texts.num.34.4: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: its limit shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
texts.num.34.5: And the border shall form a circuit from Azmon to the river of Egypt, and the limits of it shall be at the sea.
texts.num.34.6: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
texts.num.34.7: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall designate for you mount Hor:
texts.num.34.8: From mount Hor ye shall designate your border to the entrance of Hamath; and the limits of the border shall be at Zedad:
texts.num.34.9: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the limits of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
texts.num.34.10: And ye shall designate your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
texts.num.34.11: And the limit shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
texts.num.34.12: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the limits of it shall be at the salt sea: This shall be your land with its limits on all sides.
texts.num.34.13: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
texts.num.34.14: For the tribe of the children of Reuben, according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
texts.num.34.15: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side of Jordan near Jericho eastward, towards the sun-rising.
texts.num.34.16: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.34.17: These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
texts.num.34.18: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
texts.num.34.19: And the names of the men are these: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
texts.num.34.20: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
texts.num.34.21: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
texts.num.34.22: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
texts.num.34.23: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
texts.num.34.24: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
texts.num.34.25: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
texts.num.34.26: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
texts.num.34.27: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
texts.num.34.28: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
texts.num.34.29: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
texts.num.35.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
texts.num.35.2: Command the children of Israel, that they give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also to the Levites suburbs for the cities around them.
texts.num.35.3: And they shall have the cities to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
texts.num.35.4: And the suburbs of the cities which ye shall give to the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits on all sides.
texts.num.35.5: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
texts.num.35.6: And among the cities which ye shall give to the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the man-slayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
texts.num.35.7: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
texts.num.35.8: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities to the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
texts.num.35.9: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.35.10: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, When ye have passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
texts.num.35.11: Then ye shall appoint for you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, who killeth any person at unawares.
texts.num.35.12: And they shall be to you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the man-slayer may not die, until he stands before the congregation in judgment.
texts.num.35.13: And of these cities which ye shall give, six cities shall ye have for refuge.
texts.num.35.14: Ye shall give three cities on this side of Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
texts.num.35.15: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
texts.num.35.16: And if he shall smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he shall die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
texts.num.35.17: And if he shall smite him by throwing a stone, by which he may die, and he shall die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
texts.num.35.18: Or if he shall smite him with a hand-weapon of wood, with which he may die, and he shall die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
texts.num.35.19: The avenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
texts.num.35.20: But if he shall thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying in wait, that he die.
texts.num.35.21: Or in enmity shall smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
texts.num.35.22: But if he shall thrust him suddenly without enmity, or shall have cast upon him any thing without laying in wait,
texts.num.35.23: Or with any stone, by which a man may die, seeing him not, and shall cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
texts.num.35.24: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these judgments:
texts.num.35.25: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he had fled: and he shall abide in it to the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
texts.num.35.26: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he had fled;
texts.num.35.27: And the avenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the avenger of blood shall kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
texts.num.35.28: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
texts.num.35.29: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
texts.num.35.30: Whoever killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
texts.num.35.31: Moreover, ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, who is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
texts.num.35.32: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that hath fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
texts.num.35.33: So ye shall not pollute the land in which ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him that shed it.
texts.num.35.34: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, in which I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
texts.num.36.1: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
texts.num.36.2: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
texts.num.36.3: And if they shall be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be put to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received: so it will be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
texts.num.36.4: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be put to the inheritance of the tribe into which they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
texts.num.36.5: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
texts.num.36.6: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
texts.num.36.7: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
texts.num.36.8: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
texts.num.36.9: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
texts.num.36.10: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
texts.num.36.11: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father's brothers' sons:
texts.num.36.12: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
texts.num.36.13: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

texts.num.1.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai in the tent of meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year after their departure from the land of Egypt, saying,
texts.num.1.2: Take the sum of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, every male, according to their polls;
texts.num.1.3: from twenty years and upward, all that go forth to military service in Israel: ye shall number them according to their hosts, thou and Aaron.
texts.num.1.4: And with you there shall be a man for every tribe, a man who is the head of his father's house.
texts.num.1.5: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: for Reuben, Elizur the son of Shedeur;
texts.num.1.6: for Simeon, Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;
texts.num.1.7: for Judah, Nahshon the son of Amminadab;
texts.num.1.8: for Issachar, Nethaneel the son of Zuar;
texts.num.1.9: for Zebulun, Eliab the son of Helon;
texts.num.1.10: for the children of Joseph: for Ephraim, Elishama the son of Ammihud; for Manasseh, Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;
texts.num.1.11: for Benjamin, Abidan the son of Gideoni;
texts.num.1.12: for Dan, Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;
texts.num.1.13: for Asher, Pagiel the son of Ocran;
texts.num.1.14: for Gad, Eliasaph the son of Deuel;
texts.num.1.15: for Naphtali, Ahira the son of Enan.
texts.num.1.16: These were those summoned of the assembly, princes of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the thousands of Israel.
texts.num.1.17: And Moses and Aaron took these men who are expressed by their names,
texts.num.1.18: and gathered the whole assembly together on the first of the second month. And they declared their pedigrees after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, according to their polls.
texts.num.1.19: As Jehovah had commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.1.20: And the sons of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, according to their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.21: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
texts.num.1.22: Of the sons of Simeon: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, those that were numbered of them, by the number of the names, according to their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.23: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
texts.num.1.24: Of the sons of Gad: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.25: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
texts.num.1.26: Of the sons of Judah: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.27: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
texts.num.1.28: Of the sons of Issachar: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.29: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
texts.num.1.30: Of the sons of Zebulun: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.31: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
texts.num.1.32: Of the sons of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.33: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
texts.num.1.34: Of the children of Manasseh: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.35: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
texts.num.1.36: Of the sons of Benjamin: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.37: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
texts.num.1.38: Of the sons of Dan: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.39: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
texts.num.1.40: Of the sons of Asher: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.41: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
texts.num.1.42: Of the sons of Naphtali: their generations, after their families, according to their fathers' houses, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service:
texts.num.1.43: those that were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
texts.num.1.44: These are those that were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, the twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
texts.num.1.45: And all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, according to their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth to military service in Israel,
texts.num.1.46: all they that were numbered were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
texts.num.1.47: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
texts.num.1.48: For Jehovah had spoken to Moses, saying,
texts.num.1.49: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel.
texts.num.1.50: But thou, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all its vessels; and they shall serve it, and round about the tabernacle shall they encamp;
texts.num.1.51: and when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle encampeth, the Levites shall set it up; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.
texts.num.1.52: And the children of Israel shall encamp every man in his camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their hosts;
texts.num.1.53: but the Levites shall encamp round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there come not wrath upon the assembly of the children of Israel; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
texts.num.1.54: And the children of Israel did so; according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, so did they.
texts.num.2.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.num.2.2: The children of Israel shall encamp every one by his standard, with the ensign of their father's house; round about the tent of meeting, afar off, opposite to it shall they encamp.
texts.num.2.3: And [for] those encamping eastward toward the sun-rising [there shall be] the standard of the camp of Judah according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab;
texts.num.2.4: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
texts.num.2.5: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar; and the prince of the sons of Issachar shall be Nethaneel the son of Zuar;
texts.num.2.6: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty-four thousand four hundred.
texts.num.2.7: [With them shall be] the tribe of Zebulun; and the prince of the sons of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon;
texts.num.2.8: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
texts.num.2.9: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah were a hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their hosts. They shall set forth first.
texts.num.2.10: The standard of the camp of Reuben shall be southward according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur;
texts.num.2.11: and his host, even those that were numbered thereof, forty-six thousand five hundred.
texts.num.2.12: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Simeon; and the prince of the sons of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai;
texts.num.2.13: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
texts.num.2.14: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel;
texts.num.2.15: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
texts.num.2.16: All that were numbered of the camp of Reuben were a hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth second.
texts.num.2.17: And the tent of meeting shall set forth, the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so shall they set forth, every man in his place, according to their standards.
texts.num.2.18: The standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their hosts shall be westward; and the prince of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud;
texts.num.2.19: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty thousand five hundred.
texts.num.2.20: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; and the prince of the sons of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;
texts.num.2.21: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand two hundred.
texts.num.2.22: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Benjamin; and the prince of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni;
texts.num.2.23: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, thirty-five thousand four hundred.
texts.num.2.24: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were a hundred and eight thousand one hundred, according to their hosts. And they shall set forth third.
texts.num.2.25: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be northward according to their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;
texts.num.2.26: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
texts.num.2.27: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher; and the prince of the sons of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran;
texts.num.2.28: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, forty-one thousand five hundred.
texts.num.2.29: And [with them shall be] the tribe of Naphtali; and the prince of the sons of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan;
texts.num.2.30: and his host, even those that were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
texts.num.2.31: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set forth last according to their standards.
texts.num.2.32: These are those that were numbered of the children of Israel, according to their fathers' houses: all those that were numbered of the camps, according to their hosts, were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
texts.num.2.33: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.num.2.34: And the children of Israel did according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses: so they encamped according to their standards, and so they journeyed, every one according to their families, according to their fathers' houses.
texts.num.3.1: And these are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Jehovah spoke with Moses on mount Sinai.
texts.num.3.2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
texts.num.3.3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, who were consecrated to exercise the priesthood.
texts.num.3.4: And Nadab and Abihu died before Jehovah when they offered strange fire before Jehovah in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Eleazar and Ithamar exercised the priesthood in the presence of Aaron their father.
texts.num.3.5: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.6: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him;
texts.num.3.7: and they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole assembly, before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
texts.num.3.8: And they shall keep all the utensils of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
texts.num.3.9: And thou shalt give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given to him out of the children of Israel.
texts.num.3.10: And Aaron and his sons shalt thou appoint that they may attend to their priest's office; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.
texts.num.3.11: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.12: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of every firstborn that breaketh open the womb among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine;
texts.num.3.13: for every firstborn is mine. On the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both of man and beast; mine shall they be: I am Jehovah.
texts.num.3.14: And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
texts.num.3.15: Number the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, after their families; every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
texts.num.3.16: And Moses numbered them, according to the commandment of Jehovah, -- as he had been commanded.
texts.num.3.17: And these are the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
texts.num.3.18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon according to their families: Libni and Shimei.
texts.num.3.19: And the sons of Kohath according to their families: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
texts.num.3.20: And the sons of Merari according to their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
texts.num.3.21: Of Gershon, the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
texts.num.3.22: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, those that were numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.
texts.num.3.23: The families of the Gershonites encamped behind the tabernacle westward.
texts.num.3.24: And the prince of the father's house of the Gershonites was Eliasaph the son of Lael.
texts.num.3.25: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting was: the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the curtain of the entrance to the tent of meeting.
texts.num.3.26: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain of the entrance to the court, which surrounds the tabernacle and the altar, and the cords thereof for all its service.
texts.num.3.27: And of Kohath, the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
texts.num.3.28: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, who kept the charge of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.29: The families of the sons of Kohath encamped on the side of the tabernacle southward.
texts.num.3.30: And the prince of the father's house of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
texts.num.3.31: And their charge was the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the utensils of the sanctuary with which they ministered, and the curtain, and all that belongs to its service.
texts.num.3.32: And the prince of princes of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest: he had the oversight of them that kept the charge of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.33: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
texts.num.3.34: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
texts.num.3.35: And the prince of the father's house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They encamped on the side of the tabernacle northward.
texts.num.3.36: And the charge of the sons of Merari consisted in the oversight of the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its bases, and all its furniture, and all that belongs to its service,
texts.num.3.37: and the pillars of the court round about, and their bases, and their pegs, and their cords.
texts.num.3.38: And those who encamped before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrising, were Moses, and Aaron and his sons, who kept the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh near shall be put to death.
texts.num.3.39: All that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Jehovah, according to their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
texts.num.3.40: And Jehovah said to Moses, Number all the first-born males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
texts.num.3.41: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am Jehovah) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites, instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
texts.num.3.42: And Moses numbered, as Jehovah had commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
texts.num.3.43: And all the firstborn males, by the number of the names, from a month old and upward, according to their numbering, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
texts.num.3.44: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.45: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am Jehovah.
texts.num.3.46: And for those that are to be ransomed, the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are in excess over the Levites,
texts.num.3.47: thou shalt take five shekels apiece by the poll, according to the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them, -- twenty gerahs the shekel;
texts.num.3.48: and thou shalt give the money unto Aaron and unto his sons for those in excess among them who are to be ransomed.
texts.num.3.49: And Moses took the ransom-money from them that were over and above those who were ransomed by the Levites;
texts.num.3.50: of the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, a thousand three hundred and sixty-five [shekels], according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.51: And Moses gave the money of them that were ransomed to Aaron and to his sons, according to the commandment of Jehovah, -- as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.num.4.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.num.4.2: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, according to their fathers' houses,
texts.num.4.3: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, all that enter into the service, to do the work in the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.4: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting: it is most holy.
texts.num.4.5: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron and his sons shall go in, and they shall take down the veil of separation and cover the ark of testimony with it;
texts.num.4.6: and shall put thereon a covering of badgers' skin, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put its staves [to it].
texts.num.4.7: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue; and put thereon the dishes, and the cups, and the bowls, and goblets of the drink-offering; and the continual bread shall be thereon.
texts.num.4.8: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put its staves [to it].
texts.num.4.9: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff-trays, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they perform its service;
texts.num.4.10: and they shall put it and all the utensils thereof within a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put it upon a pole.
texts.num.4.11: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put its staves [to it].
texts.num.4.12: And they shall take all the instruments of service, wherewith they serve in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skin, and shall put them upon a pole.
texts.num.4.13: And they shall cleanse the altar of the ashes, and spread a purple cloth thereon;
texts.num.4.14: and they shall put upon it all the utensils thereof, wherewith they perform service about it: the firepans, the forks, and the shovels, and the bowls, -- all the utensils of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skin, and put its staves [to it].
texts.num.4.15: And when Aaron and his sons have ended covering the sanctuary, and all the utensils of the sanctuary, when the camp setteth forward, then afterwards the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the holy things, lest they die. This is what the sons of Kohath have to carry in the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.16: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall have the oversight of the oil for the light, and the fragrant incense, and the continual oblation, and the anointing oil, -- the oversight of the whole tabernacle, and of all that is therein, over the sanctuary, and over its furniture.
texts.num.4.17: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
texts.num.4.18: Ye shall not cut off the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites,
texts.num.4.19: but this shall ye do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they draw near unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden;
texts.num.4.20: but they shall not go in and see for a moment the holy things, lest they die.
texts.num.4.21: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.4.22: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, according to their fathers' houses, after their families.
texts.num.4.23: From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old shalt thou number them; every one that cometh to labour in the work, to perform the service in the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.24: This shall be the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving, and in carrying:
texts.num.4.25: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of badgers' skin that is above upon it, and the curtain of the entrance to the tent of meeting,
texts.num.4.26: and the hangings of the court, and the curtain of the entrance, of the gate of the court, which surroundeth the tabernacle and the altar, and the cords thereof, and all the instruments of their service; and all that is to be done for these things shall they perform.
