texts.num.19.2: This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without blemish, wherein is no defect, and upon which never came yoke;
texts.num.19.3: and ye shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring it outside the camp, and one shall slaughter it before him.
texts.num.19.4: And Eleazar the priest shall take of its blood with his finger, and shall sprinkle of its blood directly before the tent of meeting seven times.
texts.num.19.5: And one shall burn the heifer before his eyes; its skin and its flesh, and its blood, with its dung, shall he burn.
texts.num.19.6: And the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
texts.num.19.7: And the priest shall wash his garments, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterwards he shall come into the camp; and the priest shall be unclean until the even;
texts.num.19.8: and he that hath burned it shall wash his garments in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
texts.num.19.9: And a clean man shall gather the ashes of the heifer, and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the assembly of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
texts.num.19.10: And he that hath gathered the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even. And it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, an everlasting statute.
texts.num.19.11: He that toucheth a dead person, any dead body of a man, shall be unclean seven days.
texts.num.19.12: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
texts.num.19.13: Whoever toucheth a dead person, the dead body of a man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; for the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him: he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
texts.num.19.14: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: every one that cometh into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
texts.num.19.15: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, shall be unclean.
texts.num.19.16: And every one that toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead person, or the bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
texts.num.19.17: And they shall take for the unclean of the ashes of the purification-offering that hath been burned, and shall put running water thereon in a vessel;
texts.num.19.18: and a clean man shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, and upon all the utensils, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that hath touched the bone, or the one slain, or the dead person, or the grave;
texts.num.19.19: and the clean shall sprinkle it on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day; and he shall purify him on the seventh day; and he shall wash his garments, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
texts.num.19.20: And the man that is unclean, and doth not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the congregation, for he hath defiled the sanctuary of Jehovah: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled on him: he is unclean.
texts.num.19.21: And it shall be an everlasting statute unto them. And he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his garments, and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
texts.num.19.22: And whatever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
texts.num.20.1: And the children of Israel, the whole assembly, came into the wilderness of Zin, in the first month; and the people abode at Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
texts.num.20.2: And there was no water for the assembly, and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
texts.num.20.3: And the people contended with Moses, and spoke, saying, Would that we had died when our brethren died before Jehovah!
texts.num.20.4: And why have ye brought the congregation of Jehovah into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our beasts?
texts.num.20.5: And why have ye made us to go up out of Egypt, to bring us to this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates, neither is there any water to drink.
texts.num.20.6: And Moses and Aaron went from before the congregation to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and fell upon their faces; and the glory of Jehovah appeared to them.
texts.num.20.7: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.20.8: Take the staff, and gather the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes, and it shall give its water; and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock, and shalt give the assembly and their beasts drink.
texts.num.20.9: And Moses took the staff from before Jehovah, as he had commanded him.
texts.num.20.10: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said to them, Hear now, ye rebels: shall we bring forth to you water out of this rock?
texts.num.20.11: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his staff smote the rock twice, and much water came out, and the assembly drank, and their beasts.
texts.num.20.12: And Jehovah said to Moses and to Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to hallow me before the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land that I have given them.
texts.num.20.13: These are the waters of Meribah, where the children of Israel contended with Jehovah, and he hallowed himself in them.
texts.num.20.14: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, Thus says thy brother Israel: Thou knowest all the trouble that hath befallen us,
texts.num.20.15: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we dwelt in Egypt a long time, and the Egyptians evil entreated us and our fathers;
texts.num.20.16: and when we cried to Jehovah, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt; and behold, we are at Kadesh, a city at the extremity of thy border.
texts.num.20.17: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country; we will not pass through fields, or through vineyards, neither will we drink water out of the wells: we will go by the king's road; we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy border.
texts.num.20.18: But Edom said to him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
texts.num.20.19: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go by the high way; and if we drink of thy water, I and my cattle, then I will pay for it: I will only, without anything else, go through on my feet.
texts.num.20.20: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
texts.num.20.21: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his territory; and Israel turned away from him.
texts.num.20.22: And they removed from Kadesh; and the children of Israel, the whole assembly, came to mount Hor.
texts.num.20.23: And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron in mount Hor, on the border of the land of Edom, saying,
texts.num.20.24: Aaron shall be gathered unto his peoples; for he shall not enter into the land that I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my commandment at the waters of Meribah.
texts.num.20.25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor,
texts.num.20.26: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron shall be gathered [to his peoples], and shall die there.
texts.num.20.27: And Moses did as Jehovah had commanded, and they went up mount Hor before the eyes of the whole assembly.
texts.num.20.28: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there upon the top of the mountain; and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
texts.num.20.29: And the whole assembly saw that Aaron was dead, and they mourned for Aaron thirty days, [even] the whole house of Israel.
texts.num.21.1: And the Canaanite king of Arad, who dwelt in the south, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim, and he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
texts.num.21.2: Then Israel vowed a vow to Jehovah, and said, If thou give this people wholly into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
texts.num.21.3: And Jehovah listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them, and their cities. And they called the name of the place Hormah.
texts.num.21.4: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to go round the land of Edom; and the soul of the people became impatient on the way;
texts.num.21.5: and the people spoke against God, and against Moses, Why have ye brought us up out of Egypt that we should die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, and no water, and our soul loathes this light bread.
texts.num.21.6: Then Jehovah sent fiery serpents among the people, which bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
texts.num.21.7: And the people came to Moses and said, We have sinned, in that we have spoken against Jehovah, and against thee: pray to Jehovah that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
texts.num.21.8: And Jehovah said to Moses, Make thee a fiery [serpent], and set it upon a pole; and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, and looketh upon it, shall live.
texts.num.21.9: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole; and it came to pass, if a serpent had bitten any man, and he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
texts.num.21.10: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in Oboth.
texts.num.21.11: And they removed from Oboth, and encamped at Ijim-Abarim, in the wilderness that is before Moab, toward the sun-rising.
texts.num.21.12: From thence they removed, and encamped at the torrent Zered.
texts.num.21.13: From thence they removed, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites. For the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
texts.num.21.14: Therefore it is said in the book of the wars of Jehovah, Vaheb in Suphah, and the brooks of Arnon;
texts.num.21.15: And the stream of the brooks which turneth to the dwelling of Ar, And inclineth toward the border of Moab.
texts.num.21.16: And from thence to Beer: that is the well of which Jehovah spoke to Moses, Assemble the people, and I will give them water.
texts.num.21.17: Then Israel sang this song, Rise up, well! sing unto it:
texts.num.21.18: Well which princes digged, which the nobles of the people hollowed out at [the word of] the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness [they went] to Mattanah;
texts.num.21.19: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;
texts.num.21.20: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the fields of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks over the surface of the waste.
texts.num.21.21: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
texts.num.21.22: Let us pass through thy land; we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink water out of the wells; on the king's road will we go until we have passed thy border.
texts.num.21.23: But Sihon would not suffer Israel to go through his border; and Sihon gathered all his people, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
texts.num.21.24: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
texts.num.21.25: And Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, at Heshbon, and in all its dependent villages.
texts.num.21.26: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites; and he had fought against the former king of Moab, and had taken all his land out of his hand, even unto the Arnon.
texts.num.21.27: Therefore the poets say, Come to Heshbon; let the city of Sihon be built and established.
texts.num.21.28: For there went forth fire from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon; It consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the high places of the Arnon.
texts.num.21.29: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, people of Chemosh: He gave his sons that had escaped, and his daughters into captivity to Sihon the king of the Amorites.
texts.num.21.30: And we have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon; and we have laid [them] waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
texts.num.21.31: And Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
texts.num.21.32: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took its dependent villages, and he dispossessed the Amorites that were there.
texts.num.21.33: And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan; and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, for battle to Edrei.
texts.num.21.34: And Jehovah said to Moses, Fear him not! for into thy hand have I given him, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.
texts.num.21.35: And they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, so that they left him none remaining, and took possession of his land.
texts.num.22.1: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the plains of Moab on the other side of the Jordan from Jericho.
texts.num.22.2: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
texts.num.22.3: And Moab was much afraid of the people, because they were many; and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
texts.num.22.4: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now will this company lick up all that is round about us, as an ox licks up the green herb of the field. Now Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
texts.num.22.5: And he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is on the river in the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, a people is come out from Egypt; behold, they cover the face of the land, and they abide over against me.
texts.num.22.6: And now come, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are mightier than I: perhaps I may be able to smite them, and drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
texts.num.22.7: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed, having the rewards of divination in their hand. And they came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.
texts.num.22.8: And he said to them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, according as Jehovah shall speak unto me. And the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
texts.num.22.9: And God came to Balaam, and said, Who are these men with thee?
texts.num.22.10: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me,
texts.num.22.11: Behold, a people is come out of Egypt, and it covers the face of the land. Now come, curse me them: perhaps I may be able to fight against them, and drive them out.
texts.num.22.12: And God said to Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people; for they are blessed.
texts.num.22.13: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, Go into your land; for Jehovah refuses to give me leave to go with you.
texts.num.22.14: And the princes of Moab rose up; and they went to Balak, and said, Balaam has refused to come with us.
texts.num.22.15: Then sent Balak yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
texts.num.22.16: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor: Suffer not thyself, I pray thee, to be restrained from coming to me;
texts.num.22.17: for very highly will I honour thee, and whatever thou shalt say to me will I do; come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
texts.num.22.18: And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, If Balak give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the commandment of Jehovah my God, to do less or more.
texts.num.22.19: And now, I pray you, abide ye also here this night, and I shall know what Jehovah will say to me further.
texts.num.22.20: Then God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, If the men have come to call thee, rise up, [and] go with them; but only what I shall say unto thee shalt thou do.
texts.num.22.21: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
texts.num.22.22: And God's anger was kindled because he went; and the Angel of Jehovah set himself in the way to withstand him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two young men were with him.
texts.num.22.23: And the ass saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand; and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field, and Balaam smote the ass to turn her into the way.
texts.num.22.24: And the Angel of Jehovah stood in a hollow of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
texts.num.22.25: And the ass saw the Angel of Jehovah, and she pressed herself against the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall; and he smote her again.
texts.num.22.26: Then the Angel of Jehovah went still further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
texts.num.22.27: And the ass saw the Angel of Jehovah, and lay down under Balaam; and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with his staff.
texts.num.22.28: And Jehovah opened the mouth of the ass, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
texts.num.22.29: And Balaam said to the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now would I kill thee!
texts.num.22.30: And the ass said to Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine to this day? was I ever wont to do so to thee? And he said, No.
texts.num.22.31: Then Jehovah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed and prostrated himself on his face.
texts.num.22.32: And the Angel of Jehovah said to him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, it was I who came forth to withstand thee, for the way [thou walkest in] is for ruin before me.
texts.num.22.33: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times; had she not turned from me, I had now certainly slain thee, and saved her alive.
texts.num.22.34: And Balaam said to the Angel of Jehovah, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me; and now, if it be evil in thine eyes, I will get me back again.
texts.num.22.35: And the Angel of Jehovah said to Balaam, Go with the men, but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that shalt thou speak. And Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
texts.num.22.36: And when Balak heard that Balaam came, he went out to meet him, to the city of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is at the extremity of the border.
texts.num.22.37: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not earnestly send to thee to call thee? why didst thou not come to me? am I not surely able to honour thee?
texts.num.22.38: And Balaam said to Balak, Lo, I am come to thee; but shall I now be able at all to say anything? the word that God puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.
texts.num.22.39: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjath-huzoth.
texts.num.22.40: And Balak offered oxen and small cattle, and sent to Balaam and to the princes that were with him.
texts.num.22.41: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up to the high places of Baal, and he saw from thence the extremity of the people.
texts.num.23.1: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
texts.num.23.2: And Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam offered up a bullock and a ram on [each] altar.
texts.num.23.3: And Balaam said to Balak, Stand by thy burnt-offering, and I will go; perhaps Jehovah will come to meet me; and whatever he shews me I will tell thee. And he went to a hill.
texts.num.23.4: And God met Balaam; and [Balaam] said to him, I have disposed seven altars, and have offered up a bullock and a ram upon [each] altar.
texts.num.23.5: And Jehovah put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.
texts.num.23.6: And he returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt-offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
texts.num.23.7: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, from the mountains of the east: Come, curse me Jacob, and come, denounce Israel!
texts.num.23.8: How shall I curse whom ùGod hath not cursed? or how shall I denounce whom Jehovah doth not denounce?
texts.num.23.9: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: Lo, [it is] a people that shall dwell alone and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
texts.num.23.10: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let my soul die the death of the righteous, and let my end be like his!
texts.num.23.11: And Balak said to Balaam, What hast thou done to me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
texts.num.23.12: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Jehovah puts in my mouth?
texts.num.23.13: And Balak said to him, Come, I pray thee, with me to another place, from whence thou wilt see them; thou shalt see only the extremity of them and shalt not see them all, and curse me them from thence.
texts.num.23.14: And he took him to the watchmen's field, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bullock and a ram on [each] altar.
texts.num.23.15: And [Balaam] said to Balak, Stand here by thy burnt-offering, and I will go to meet yonder.
texts.num.23.16: And Jehovah met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Return to Balak, and thus shalt thou speak.
texts.num.23.17: And he came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt-offering, and the princes of Moab with him; and Balak said to him, What has Jehovah spoken?
texts.num.23.18: Then he took up his parable and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear! hearken unto me, son of Zippor!
texts.num.23.19: ùGod is not a man, that he should lie; neither a son of man, that he should repent. Shall he say and not do? and shall he speak and not make it good?
texts.num.23.20: Behold, I have received [mission] to bless; and he hath blessed, and I cannot reverse it.
texts.num.23.21: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen wrong in Israel; Jehovah his God is with him, and the shout of a king is in his midst.
texts.num.23.22: ùGod brought him out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of a buffalo.
texts.num.23.23: For there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. At this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath ùGod wrought!
texts.num.23.24: Lo, the people will rise up as a lioness, and lift himself up as a lion. He shall not lie down until he have eaten the prey and drunk the blood of the slain.
texts.num.23.25: And Balak said to Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
texts.num.23.26: And Balaam answered and said to Balak, Did I not tell thee, saying, All that Jehovah shall speak, that will I do?
texts.num.23.27: And Balak said to Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee to another place; perhaps it will be right in the sight of God that thou curse me them from thence.
texts.num.23.28: And Balak brought Balaam to the top of Peor, which looks over the surface of the waste.
texts.num.23.29: And Balaam said to Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
texts.num.23.30: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bullock and a ram on each altar.
texts.num.24.1: And Balaam saw that it was good in the sight of Jehovah to bless Israel, and he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
texts.num.24.2: And Balaam lifted up his eyes and saw Israel dwelling [in tents] according to his tribes; and the Spirit of God came upon him.
texts.num.24.3: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, and the man of opened eye saith,
texts.num.24.4: He saith, who heareth the words of ùGod, who seeth the vision of the Almighty, who falleth down, and who hath his eyes open:
texts.num.24.5: How goodly are thy tents, Jacob, and thy tabernacles, Israel!
texts.num.24.6: Like valleys are they spread forth, like gardens by the river side, Like aloe-trees which Jehovah hath planted, like cedars beside the waters.
texts.num.24.7: Water shall flow out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in great waters, And his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
texts.num.24.8: ùGod brought him out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of a buffalo. He shall consume the nations his enemies, and break their bones, and with his arrows shall smite [them] in pieces.
texts.num.24.9: He stooped, he lay down like a lion, and like a lioness: who will stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
texts.num.24.10: Then Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and behold, thou hast altogether blessed [them] these three times!
texts.num.24.11: And now flee thou to thy place; I said I would very highly honour thee, and behold, Jehovah has kept thee back from honour.
texts.num.24.12: And Balaam said to Balak, Did I not also speak to thy messengers whom thou sentest to me, saying,
texts.num.24.13: If Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the commandment of Jehovah to do good or bad out of my heart: what Jehovah shall say, that will I speak?
texts.num.24.14: And now behold, I go to my people: come, I will admonish thee what this people will do to thy people at the end of days.
texts.num.24.15: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, and the man of opened eye saith,
texts.num.24.16: He saith, who heareth the words of ùGod, who knoweth the knowledge of the Most High, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, who falleth down, and who hath his eyes open:
texts.num.24.17: I shall see him, but not now; I shall behold him, but not nigh: There cometh a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and he shall cut in pieces the corners of Moab, and destroy all the sons of tumult.
texts.num.24.18: And Edom shall be a possession, and Seir a possession, -- they, his enemies; but Israel will do valiantly.
texts.num.24.19: And one out of Jacob shall have dominion, and will destroy out of the city what remaineth.
texts.num.24.20: And he saw Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, Amalek is the first of the nations, but his latter end shall be for destruction.
texts.num.24.21: And he saw the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Firm is thy dwelling-place, and thy nest fixed in the rock;
texts.num.24.22: But the Kenite shall be consumed, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
texts.num.24.23: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas! Who shall live when ùGod doeth this?
texts.num.24.24: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and afflict Asshur, and afflict Eber, and he also shall be for destruction.
texts.num.24.25: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.
texts.num.25.1: And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to commit fornication with the daughters of Moab.
texts.num.25.2: And they invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods; and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.
texts.num.25.3: And Israel joined himself to Baal-Peor; and the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel.
texts.num.25.4: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up to Jehovah before the sun, that the fierce anger of Jehovah may be turned away from Israel.
texts.num.25.5: And Moses said to the judges of Israel, Slay every one his men that have joined themselves to Baal-Peor.
texts.num.25.6: And behold, a man of the children of Israel came and brought a Midianitish woman to his brethren, in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the entrance of the tent of meeting.
texts.num.25.7: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, and rose up from among the assembly, and took a javelin in his hand,
texts.num.25.8: and he went after the man of Israel into the tent-chamber, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel and the woman through her belly. And the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
texts.num.25.9: And those that died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
texts.num.25.10: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.25.11: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
texts.num.25.12: Therefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace!
texts.num.25.13: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.
texts.num.25.14: And the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, the prince of a father's house of the Simeonites.
texts.num.25.15: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was tribal head of a father's house in Midian.
texts.num.25.16: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.25.17: Harass the Midianites, and smite them,
texts.num.25.18: for they have harassed you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague because of the matter of Peor.
texts.num.26.1: And it came to pass after the plague, that Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
texts.num.26.2: Take the sum of the whole assembly of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, according to their fathers' houses, all that go forth to military service in Israel.
texts.num.26.3: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,
texts.num.26.4: From twenty years old and upward ...; as Jehovah had commanded Moses and the children of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt.
texts.num.26.5: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: the children of Reuben: [of] Enoch, the family of the Enochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
texts.num.26.6: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
texts.num.26.7: These are the families of the Reubenites; and they that were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
texts.num.26.8: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab;
texts.num.26.9: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, summoned of the assembly, who contended against Moses and against Aaron in the band of Korah, when they contended against Jehovah.
texts.num.26.10: And the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that band died, when the fire devoured the two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.
texts.num.26.11: But the children of Korah died not.
texts.num.26.12: The sons of Simeon, after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;
texts.num.26.13: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites; of Saul, the family of the Saulites.
texts.num.26.14: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
texts.num.26.15: The children of Gad, after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni,the family of the Shunites;
texts.num.26.16: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;
texts.num.26.17: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
texts.num.26.18: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand five hundred.
texts.num.26.19: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
texts.num.26.20: And the sons of Judah, after their families: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Pherez, the family of the Pharzites; of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
texts.num.26.21: And the sons of Pherez: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
texts.num.26.22: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
texts.num.26.23: The sons of Issachar, after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puah, the family of the Punites;
texts.num.26.24: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
texts.num.26.25: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
texts.num.26.26: The sons of Zebulun, after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
texts.num.26.27: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, sixty thousand five hundred.
texts.num.26.28: The sons of Joseph, after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
texts.num.26.29: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites (and Machir begot Gilead); of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
texts.num.26.30: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helkites;
texts.num.26.31: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
texts.num.26.32: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
texts.num.26.33: -- And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
texts.num.26.34: -- These are the families of Manasseh; and those that were numbered of them, fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
texts.num.26.35: These are the sons of Ephraim, after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites; of Becher, the family of the Bachrites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
texts.num.26.36: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
texts.num.26.37: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
texts.num.26.38: The sons of Benjamin, after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
texts.num.26.39: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
texts.num.26.40: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman; [of Ard] the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
texts.num.26.41: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
texts.num.26.42: These are the sons of Dan, after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
texts.num.26.43: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
texts.num.26.44: The sons of Asher, after their families: of Jimnah, the family of the Jimnites; of Jishvi, the family of the Jishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
texts.num.26.45: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
texts.num.26.46: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
texts.num.26.47: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
texts.num.26.48: The sons of Naphtali, after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
texts.num.26.49: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
texts.num.26.50: These are the families of Naphtali, according to their families; and they that were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
texts.num.26.51: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
texts.num.26.52: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.26.53: Unto these shall the land be divided for an inheritance according to the number of the names;
texts.num.26.54: to the many thou shalt increase their inheritance, and to the few thou shalt diminish their inheritance; to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
texts.num.26.55: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot; according to the names of the tribes of their fathers shall they inherit;
texts.num.26.56: according to lot shall his inheritance be divided to each, be they many or few in number.
texts.num.26.57: And these are the numbered of the Levites, after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
texts.num.26.58: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. -- And Kohath begot Amram.
texts.num.26.59: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
texts.num.26.60: And to Aaron were born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
texts.num.26.61: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they presented strange fire before Jehovah.
texts.num.26.62: And those that were numbered of the [Levites] were twenty-three thousand, all males from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
texts.num.26.63: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.
texts.num.26.64: But among these there was not a man numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.26.65: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
texts.num.27.1: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
texts.num.27.2: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and the whole assembly, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,
texts.num.27.3: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the band of them that banded themselves together against Jehovah in the band of Korah; but he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.
texts.num.27.4: Why should the name of our father be taken away from his family, because he has no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.
texts.num.27.5: And Moses brought their cause before Jehovah.
texts.num.27.6: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.27.7: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
texts.num.27.8: And unto the children of Israel shalt thou speak, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
texts.num.27.9: And if he have no daughter, ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
texts.num.27.10: And if he have no brethren, ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
texts.num.27.11: And if his father have no brethren, ye shall give his inheritance to his kinsman that is nearest to him in his family, and he shall possess it; and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of right, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
texts.num.27.12: And Jehovah said to Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land that I have given unto the children of Israel.
texts.num.27.13: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy peoples, as Aaron thy brother was gathered,
texts.num.27.14: because ye rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, as to hallowing me in the matter of the water before their eyes. (That is the water of Meribah at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)
texts.num.27.15: And Moses spoke to Jehovah, saying,
texts.num.27.16: Let Jehovah, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the assembly,
texts.num.27.17: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the assembly of Jehovah be not as sheep that have no shepherd.
texts.num.27.18: And Jehovah said to Moses, Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and thou shalt lay thy hand upon him;
texts.num.27.19: and thou shalt set him before Eleazar the priest, and before the whole assembly; and give him commandment before their eyes.
texts.num.27.20: And thou shalt put of thine honour upon him, that the whole assembly of the children of Israel may obey him.
texts.num.27.21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him, by the judgment of the Urim before Jehovah: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, he, and all the children of Israel with him, even the whole assembly.
texts.num.27.22: And Moses did as Jehovah had commanded him; and he took Joshua and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before the whole assembly.
texts.num.27.23: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him commandment, as Jehovah had said through Moses.
texts.num.28.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.28.2: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, my bread for my offerings by fire of sweet odour to me, shall ye take heed to present to me at their set time.
texts.num.28.3: And say unto them, This is the offering by fire which ye shall present to Jehovah: two yearling lambs without blemish, day by day, as a continual burnt-offering.
texts.num.28.4: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings;
texts.num.28.5: and a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for an oblation, mingled with beaten oil, a fourth part of a hin:
texts.num.28.6: [it is] the continual burnt-offering which was ordained on mount Sinai for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.num.28.7: And the drink-offering thereof shall be a fourth part of a hin for one lamb; in the sanctuary shall the drink-offering of strong drink be poured out to Jehovah.
texts.num.28.8: And the second lamb thou shalt offer between the two evenings; [with the] like oblation as that of the morning, and the like drink-offering, shalt thou offer it as an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah.
texts.num.28.9: And on the sabbath day two yearling lambs without blemish, and two tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, and the drink-offering thereof:
texts.num.28.10: it is the burnt-offering of the sabbath, for each sabbath besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.28.11: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall present a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish.
texts.num.28.12: And three tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth parts of fine flour as an oblation, mingled with oil, for the ram;
texts.num.28.13: and a tenth part of fine flour mingled with oil as an oblation for each lamb: [it is] a burnt-offering of a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.num.28.14: And their drink-offerings: half a hin of wine for a bullock, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the monthly burnt-offering for each month throughout the months of the year.
texts.num.28.15: And a buck of the goats shall be offered, for a sin-offering to Jehovah, besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.28.16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the passover to Jehovah.
texts.num.28.17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast; seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
texts.num.28.18: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do;
texts.num.28.19: and ye shall present an offering by fire, a burnt-offering to Jehovah: two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven yearling lambs; they shall be unto you without blemish;
texts.num.28.20: and their oblation shall be of fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth parts for the ram;
texts.num.28.21: one tenth part shalt thou offer for each lamb, of the seven lambs;
texts.num.28.22: and a he-goat as a sin-offering, to make atonement for you.
texts.num.28.23: Besides the burnt-offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt-offering, shall ye offer this.
texts.num.28.24: After this manner ye shall offer daily, seven days, the bread of the offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt-offering, and its drink-offering.
texts.num.28.25: And on the seventh day ye shall have a holy convocation; no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.num.28.26: And on the day of the first-fruits, when ye present a new oblation to Jehovah, after your weeks, ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.num.28.27: And ye shall present a burnt-offering for a sweet odour to Jehovah: two young bullocks, one ram, seven yearling lambs;
texts.num.28.28: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for one bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,
texts.num.28.29: one tenth part for each lamb of the seven lambs;
texts.num.28.30: [and] one buck of the goats, to make atonement for you.
texts.num.28.31: Ye shall offer them besides the continual burnt-offering, and its oblation (without blemish shall they be unto you), and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.1: And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do; a day of blowing the trumpets shall it be unto you.
texts.num.29.2: And ye shall offer a burnt-offering for a sweet odour to Jehovah: one young bullock, one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.3: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,
texts.num.29.4: and one tenth part for each lamb of the seven lambs;
texts.num.29.5: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, to make atonement for you,
texts.num.29.6: -- besides the monthly burnt-offering and its oblation, and the continual burnt-offering and its oblation, and their drink-offerings, according to their ordinance, for a sweet odour, an offering by fire to Jehovah.
texts.num.29.7: And on the tenth of this seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls; no manner of work shall ye do.
texts.num.29.8: And ye shall present a burnt-offering to Jehovah for a sweet odour: one young bullock, one ram, seven yearling lambs (without blemish shall they be unto you);
texts.num.29.9: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil, three tenth parts for the bullock, two tenth parts for the ram,
texts.num.29.10: one tenth part for each lamb, of the seven lambs;
texts.num.29.11: [and] one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, -- besides the sin-offering of atonement, and the continual burnt-offering and its oblation, and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have a holy convocation: no manner of servile work shall ye do; and ye shall celebrate a feast to Jehovah seven days;
texts.num.29.13: and ye shall present a burnt-offering, an offering by fire for a sweet odour to Jehovah: thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs (they shall be without blemish);
texts.num.29.14: and their oblation of fine flour mingled with oil: three tenth parts for each bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,
texts.num.29.15: and one tenth part for each lamb of the fourteen lambs;
texts.num.29.16: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.17: And on the second day, [ye shall present] twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.18: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
texts.num.29.19: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation, and their drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.20: And on the third day, eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.21: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
texts.num.29.22: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.23: And on the fourth day, ten bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.24: their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
texts.num.29.25: and one buck of the goats for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.26: And on the fifth day, nine bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.27: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
texts.num.29.28: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.29: And on the sixth day, eight bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.30: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
texts.num.29.31: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offerings.
texts.num.29.32: And on the seventh day, seven bullocks, two rams, fourteen yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.33: and their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to their ordinance;
texts.num.29.34: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering, its oblation and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.35: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: no manner of servile work shall ye do.
texts.num.29.36: And ye shall present a burnt-offering, an offering by fire of a sweet odour to Jehovah: one bullock, one ram, seven yearling lambs without blemish;
texts.num.29.37: their oblation and their drink-offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
texts.num.29.38: and one he-goat for a sin-offering, -- besides the continual burnt-offering and its oblation and its drink-offering.
texts.num.29.39: These shall ye offer to Jehovah in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your voluntary-offerings, for your burnt-offerings, and for your oblations, and for your drink-offerings, and for your peace-offerings.
texts.num.29.40: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.num.30.1: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is what Jehovah hath commanded.
texts.num.30.2: If a man vow a vow to Jehovah, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; according to all that hath gone out of his mouth shall he do.
texts.num.30.3: If a woman also vow a vow to Jehovah, and bind herself by a bond, in her father's house in her youth,
texts.num.30.4: and her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall be silent at her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
texts.num.30.5: But if her father prohibited her in the day that he heard, none of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand; and Jehovah shall pardon her, because her father prohibited her.
texts.num.30.6: And if she have a husband, when she hath her vow upon her or ought that hath passed her lips wherewith she hath bound her soul,
texts.num.30.7: and her husband hear it and be silent at her in the day that he heareth it, then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
texts.num.30.8: But if her husband prohibit her on the day that he heareth it, and annul her vow which is upon her, and what hath passed her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul, then Jehovah shall pardon her.
texts.num.30.9: But the vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, -- everything wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand against her.
texts.num.30.10: And if she have vowed in her husband's house, or have bound her soul by an oath with a bond,
texts.num.30.11: and her husband have heard it, and been silent at her, and hath not prohibited her, then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
texts.num.30.12: But if her husband have expressly annulled them on the day that he heard them, then nothing of that which is gone out of her lips as to her vows or the bond on her soul, shall stand: her husband hath annulled them; and Jehovah will pardon her.
texts.num.30.13: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband can establish it, or her husband can annul it.
texts.num.30.14: And if her husband be altogether silent at her from day to day, then he hath established all her vows or all her bonds which are upon her; he hath confirmed them, for he hath been silent at her in the day that he heard them.
texts.num.30.15: But if he in any way annul them after he hath heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.
texts.num.30.16: These are the statutes, which Jehovah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, in her youth in her father's house.
texts.num.31.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.31.2: Avenge the children of Israel upon the Midianites; afterwards shalt thou be gathered unto thy peoples.
texts.num.31.3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, Arm from amongst you men for military service, that they go against Midian to execute Jehovah's vengeance upon Midian.
texts.num.31.4: Of every tribe a thousand, of all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
texts.num.31.5: And there were levied out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand by tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
texts.num.31.6: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand by the tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, and the holy instruments, even the alarm-trumpets in his hand.
texts.num.31.7: And they warred against Midian, as Jehovah had commanded Moses, and slew all the males.
texts.num.31.8: And they slew the kings of Midian, besides the others slain, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian; and Balaam the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
texts.num.31.9: And the children of Israel took the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took for a spoil all their cattle and all their flocks and all their goods;
texts.num.31.10: and all their cities in their settlements and all their encampments they burned with fire.
texts.num.31.11: And they took all the booty, and all the prey, of man and of cattle;
texts.num.31.12: and they brought to Moses and Eleazar the priest, and to the assembly of the children of Israel, the captives and the prey and the booty, to the camp in the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan of Jericho.
texts.num.31.13: And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the princes of the assembly went forth to meet them outside the camp.
texts.num.31.14: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the army, with the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war;
texts.num.31.15: and Moses said to them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
texts.num.31.16: Lo, these, through the counsel of Balaam, caused the children of Israel to commit sin against Jehovah in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague on the assembly of Jehovah.
texts.num.31.17: And now slay every male among the little ones, and slay every woman that hath known man by lying with him,
texts.num.31.18: but all the children among the women that have not known lying with a man, keep alive for yourselves.
texts.num.31.19: And encamp outside the camp seven days; whoever hath killed a person, and whoever hath touched any slain; ye shall purify yourselves on the third day, and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
texts.num.31.20: And every garment, and every vessel of skin, and all work of goat's hair, and every utensil of wood shall ye purify.
texts.num.31.21: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of war that had gone to the battle, This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.22: Only the gold, and the silver, the copper, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
texts.num.31.23: everything that passeth through the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean; only it shall be purified with the water of separation; and everything that cannot pass through the fire ye shall make go through the water.
texts.num.31.24: And ye shall wash your garments on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean; and afterwards ye may come into the camp.
texts.num.31.25: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.31.26: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, of man and of cattle, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the assembly;
texts.num.31.27: and divide the prey into halves, between them that conducted the war, who went out to the battle, and the whole assembly.
texts.num.31.28: And thou shalt levy a tribute for Jehovah of the men of war who went out to the army, one soul of five hundred of the persons, and of the oxen, and of the asses, and of the small cattle.
texts.num.31.29: Of their half shall ye take it, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for a heave-offering of Jehovah.
texts.num.31.30: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the oxen, of the asses, and of the small cattle, of every [kind of] beasts, and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, who keep the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah.
texts.num.31.31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.32: And the prey, the rest of the spoil, which the men of war had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,
texts.num.31.35: and of human persons, of the women that had not known lying with a man, all the persons were thirty-two thousand.
texts.num.31.36: And the half, the portion of them that had gone out to the war, was in number three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
texts.num.31.37: and the tribute for Jehovah of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five;
texts.num.31.38: and the oxen were thirty-six thousand, and the tribute thereof for Jehovah, seventy-two;
texts.num.31.39: and the asses were thirty thousand five hundred, and the tribute thereof for Jehovah, sixty-one;
texts.num.31.40: and the human persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the tribute for Jehovah was thirty-two persons.
texts.num.31.41: And Moses gave the tribute of Jehovah's heave-offering to Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.42: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses had divided, [taking it] from the men that served in the war,
texts.num.31.43: (now the half belonging to the assembly was of the sheep, three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred,
texts.num.31.45: and thirty thousand five hundred asses,
texts.num.31.47: ... of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, of man and of cattle, and gave them to the Levites who kept the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
texts.num.31.48: And the officers who were over the thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near to Moses,
texts.num.31.49: and they said to Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war who were under our hand, and there is not one man of us lacking.
texts.num.31.50: So we present the offering of Jehovah, that which each one hath found, jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Jehovah.
texts.num.31.51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, all manner of wrought jewels.
texts.num.31.52: And all the gold of the heave-offering that they offered to Jehovah was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, from the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds.
texts.num.31.53: (The men of war had taken spoil each one for himself.)
texts.num.31.54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of meeting, as a memorial for the children of Israel before Jehovah.
texts.num.32.1: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had much cattle, a very great multitude; and they saw the land of Jaazer, and the land of Gilead, and behold, the place was a place for cattle.
texts.num.32.2: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the assembly, saying,
texts.num.32.3: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jaazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
texts.num.32.4: the country that Jehovah smote before the assembly of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle;
texts.num.32.5: and they said, If we have found favour in thine eyes, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession: bring us not over the Jordan.
texts.num.32.6: And Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall *ye* abide here?
texts.num.32.7: And why do ye discourage the children of Israel from going over into the land that Jehovah has given them?
texts.num.32.8: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land:
texts.num.32.9: they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, and discouraged the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land that Jehovah had given them.
texts.num.32.10: And Jehovah's anger was kindled the same time, and he swore, saying,
texts.num.32.11: If the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob! for they have not wholly followed me;
texts.num.32.12: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; for they have wholly followed Jehovah.
texts.num.32.13: And Jehovah's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation was consumed that had done evil in the eyes of Jehovah.
texts.num.32.14: And behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, a progeny of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.
texts.num.32.15: If ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
texts.num.32.16: And they drew near to him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones;
texts.num.32.17: but we ourselves will go with diligence armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones shall dwell in the strong cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
texts.num.32.18: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited each one his inheritance.
texts.num.32.19: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side the Jordan, and further, because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side the Jordan eastward.
texts.num.32.20: And Moses said to them, If ye do this thing, if ye arm yourselves before Jehovah for war,
texts.num.32.21: and all of you that are armed go over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he have dispossessed his enemies from before him,
texts.num.32.22: and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and afterwards ye return, ye shall be guiltless toward Jehovah and toward Israel, and this land shall be your possession before Jehovah.
texts.num.32.23: But if ye do not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah, and be sure your sin will find you out.
texts.num.32.24: Build yourselves cities for your little ones, and folds for your flocks, and do that which has gone out of your mouth.
texts.num.32.25: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commands.
texts.num.32.26: Our little ones, our wives, our cattle, and all our beasts shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
texts.num.32.27: but thy servants will pass over, every one armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord says.
texts.num.32.28: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.
texts.num.32.29: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben pass with you over the Jordan, every one armed for battle, before Jehovah, and the land be subdued before you, then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
texts.num.32.30: but if they do not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
texts.num.32.31: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah has said to thy servants, so will we do.
texts.num.32.32: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance on this side the Jordan shall be ours.
texts.num.32.33: And Moses gave to them, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og the king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and territories, the cities of the land round about.
texts.num.32.34: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
texts.num.32.35: and Atroth-Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbebah,
texts.num.32.36: and Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-haran, strong cities, and sheepfolds.
texts.num.32.37: -- And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Kirjathaim,
texts.num.32.38: and Nebo, and Baal-meon (of which the names were changed), and Sibmah; and they gave other names to the cities that they built.
texts.num.32.39: -- And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and they dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.
texts.num.32.40: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
texts.num.32.41: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took their hamlets, and called them Havoth-Jair.
texts.num.32.42: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its dependent villages, and called it Nobah, after his name.
texts.num.33.1: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt according to their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
texts.num.33.2: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Jehovah; and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
texts.num.33.3: They journeyed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
texts.num.33.4: And the Egyptians buried those whom Jehovah had smitten among them, all the firstborn; and upon their gods Jehovah executed judgments.
texts.num.33.5: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.
texts.num.33.6: And they removed from Succoth and encamped in Etham, which is at the end of the wilderness.
texts.num.33.7: And they removed from Etham, and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which is opposite Baal-Zephon, and encamped before Migdol.
texts.num.33.8: And they removed from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
texts.num.33.9: And they removed from Marah, and came to Elim; and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm-trees, and they encamped there.
texts.num.33.10: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
texts.num.33.11: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
texts.num.33.12: And they removed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
texts.num.33.13: And they removed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
texts.num.33.14: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
texts.num.33.15: And they removed from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.33.16: And they removed from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
texts.num.33.17: And they removed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
texts.num.33.18: And they removed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
texts.num.33.19: And they removed from Rithmah, and encamped at Rimmon-perez.
texts.num.33.20: And they removed from Rimmon-perez, and encamped in Libnah.
texts.num.33.21: And they removed from Libnah, and encamped at Rissah.
texts.num.33.22: And they removed from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.
texts.num.33.23: And they removed from Kehelathah, and encamped in mount Shapher.
texts.num.33.24: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
texts.num.33.25: And they removed from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.
texts.num.33.26: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
texts.num.33.27: And they removed from Tahath, and encamped at Terah.
texts.num.33.28: And they removed from Terah, and encamped in Mithcah.
texts.num.33.29: And they removed from Mithcah, and encamped in Hashmonah.
texts.num.33.30: And they removed from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.
texts.num.33.31: And they removed from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene-Jaakan.
texts.num.33.32: And they removed from Bene-Jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
texts.num.33.33: And they removed from Hor-hagidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
texts.num.33.34: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Abronah.
texts.num.33.35: And they removed from Abronah, and encamped at Ezion-geber.
texts.num.33.36: And they removed from Ezion-geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
texts.num.33.37: And they removed from Kadesh, and encamped in mount Hor, in the border of the land of Edom.
texts.num.33.38: And Aaron the priest went up mount Hor by the commandment of Jehovah, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month.
texts.num.33.39: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on mount Hor.
texts.num.33.40: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad who dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
texts.num.33.41: And they removed from mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
texts.num.33.42: And they removed from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.
texts.num.33.43: And they removed from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.
texts.num.33.44: And they removed from Oboth, and encamped in Ijim-Abarim, in the border of Moab.
texts.num.33.45: And they removed from Ijim, and encamped in Dibon-Gad.
texts.num.33.46: And they removed from Dibon-Gad, and encamped in Almon-Diblathaim.
texts.num.33.47: And they removed from Almon-Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
texts.num.33.48: And they removed from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho.
texts.num.33.49: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth unto Abel-Shittim, in the plains of Moab.
texts.num.33.50: And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,
texts.num.33.51: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over Jordan into the land of Canaan,
texts.num.33.52: then ye shall dispossess all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and ye shall destroy all their figured images, and all their molten images shall ye destroy, and all their high places shall ye lay waste;
texts.num.33.53: and ye shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein, for to you have I given the land to possess it.
texts.num.33.54: And ye shall take for yourselves the land as an inheritance by lot according to your families: to the many ye shall increase their inheritance, and to the few thou shalt diminish their inheritance: where the lot falleth to him, there shall be each man's [inheritance]; according to the tribes of your fathers shall ye take for yourselves the inheritance.
texts.num.33.55: But if ye will not dispossess the inhabitants of the land from before you, those that ye let remain of them shall be thorns in your eyes, and pricks in your sides, and they shall harass you in the land wherein ye dwell.
texts.num.33.56: And it shall come to pass that I will do unto you as I thought to do unto them.
texts.num.34.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.34.2: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan, this shall be the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof.
texts.num.34.3: Then your south side shall be from the wilderness of Zin alongside of Edom, and your southern border shall be from the end of the salt sea eastward;
texts.num.34.4: and your border shall turn from the south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin, and shall end southward at Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-Addar, and pass on to Azmon.
texts.num.34.5: And the border shall turn from Azmon unto the torrent of Egypt, and shall end at the sea.
texts.num.34.6: And as west border ye shall have the great sea, and [its] coast. This shall be your west border.
texts.num.34.7: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;
texts.num.34.8: from mount Hor ye shall mark out the entrance to Hamath, and the end of the border shall be toward Zedad;
texts.num.34.9: and the border shall go to Ziphron, and shall end at Hazar-enan. This shall be your north border.
texts.num.34.10: And ye shall mark out for you as eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
texts.num.34.11: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall strike upon the extremity of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;
texts.num.34.12: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and shall end at the salt sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.
texts.num.34.13: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall take for yourselves as inheritance by lot, which Jehovah commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe.
texts.num.34.14: For the tribe of the children of the Reubenites according to their fathers' houses, and the tribe of the children of the Gadites according to their fathers' houses, have received, and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance;
texts.num.34.15: the two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side the Jordan of Jericho eastward, toward the sun-rising.
texts.num.34.16: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.34.17: These are the names of the men who shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
texts.num.34.18: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land.
texts.num.34.19: And these are the names of the men: for the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;
texts.num.34.20: and for the tribe of the children of Simeon, Samuel the son of Ammihud;
texts.num.34.21: for the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon;
texts.num.34.22: and for the tribe of the children of Dan, a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli;
texts.num.34.23: for the children of Joseph: for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod,
texts.num.34.24: and for the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan;
texts.num.34.25: and for the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a prince, Elizaphan the son of Pharnach;
texts.num.34.26: and for the tribe of the children of Issachar, a prince, Phaltiel the son of Azzan;
texts.num.34.27: and for the tribe of the children of Asher, a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi;
texts.num.34.28: and for the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a prince, Phedahel the son of Ammihud.
texts.num.34.29: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to distribute to the children of Israel their inheritance in the land of Canaan.
texts.num.35.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan of Jericho, saying,
texts.num.35.2: Command the children of Israel, that of the inheritance of their possession they give unto the Levites cities to dwell in; and a suburb for the cities round about them shall ye give unto the Levites.
