texts.num.35.3: And the cities shall they have to dwell in, and their suburbs shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
texts.num.35.4: And the suburbs of the cities that ye shall give unto the Levites shall be from the walls of the city outward, a thousand cubits round about.
texts.num.35.5: And ye shall measure, without the city, the east side two thousand cubits, and the south side two thousand cubits, and the west side two thousand cubits, and the north side two thousand cubits, and the city shall be in the midst: they shall have this as suburbs of the cities.
texts.num.35.6: And [among] the cities that ye shall give unto the Levites [shall be] the six cities of refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither, -- and besides them ye shall give forty-two cities:
texts.num.35.7: all the cities that ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities, they and their suburbs.
texts.num.35.8: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have much ye shall take much, and from them that have little ye shall take little; each one according to his inheritance which he will inherit shall give of his cities to the Levites.
texts.num.35.9: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
texts.num.35.10: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
texts.num.35.11: then ye shall appoint for yourselves cities: cities of refuge shall they be for you; that a manslayer may flee thither, who without intent smiteth a person mortally.
texts.num.35.12: And ye shall have these cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he have stood before the assembly in judgment.
texts.num.35.13: And the cities that ye shall give shall be six cities of refuge for you.
texts.num.35.14: Three cities shall ye give on this side of the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.
texts.num.35.15: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them shall these six cities be a refuge, that one who smiteth a person mortally without intent may flee thither.
texts.num.35.16: And if he have smitten him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall certainly be put to death.
texts.num.35.17: And if he have smitten him with a stone from the hand, wherewith one may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall certainly be put to death.
texts.num.35.18: Or if he have smitten him with an instrument of wood, in the hand, wherewith one may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall certainly be put to death;
texts.num.35.19: the avenger of blood, he shall put the murderer to death; when he meeteth him, he shall put him to death.
texts.num.35.20: And if he thrust at him out of hatred, or hurl at him intentionally, so that he die,
texts.num.35.21: or from enmity smite him with his hand, so that he die, he that smote him shall certainly be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meeteth him. --
texts.num.35.22: But if he have thrust at him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him anything unintentionally,
texts.num.35.23: or [have smitten him] with any stone wherewith one may die, without seeing him, and have cast it upon him so that he die, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
texts.num.35.24: then the assembly shall judge between the smiter and the avenger of blood according to these judgments;
texts.num.35.25: and the assembly shall rescue the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the assembly shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he had fled; and he shall abide in it until the death of the high-priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
texts.num.35.26: But if the manslayer shall in any way come outside the limits of the city of his refuge whither he hath fled,
texts.num.35.27: and the avenger of blood find him outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kill the manslayer, there shall be no blood-guiltiness upon him;
texts.num.35.28: for the manslayer should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high-priest; but after the death of the high-priest he may return into the land of his possession.
texts.num.35.29: And this shall be unto you a statute of right throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
texts.num.35.30: Whoever shall smite a person mortally, at the mouth of witnesses shall the murderer be put to death; but one witness shall not testify against a person to cause him to die.
texts.num.35.31: And ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, who is guilty of death, but he shall certainly be put to death.
texts.num.35.32: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that hath fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
texts.num.35.33: And ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are; for blood, it polluteth the land; and there can be no atonement made for the land, for the blood that hath been shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
texts.num.35.34: And ye shall not defile the land that ye inhabit, in the midst whereof I dwell; for I am Jehovah who dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.
texts.num.36.1: And the chief fathers of families of the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
texts.num.36.2: and they said, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel; and my lord was commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.
texts.num.36.3: Now if they be married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong; and it shall be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
texts.num.36.4: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall come, then shall their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong; and their inheritance shall be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
texts.num.36.5: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Jehovah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
texts.num.36.6: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry whom they please; only they shall marry one of the tribe of their father,
texts.num.36.7: that no inheritance of the children of Israel pass from tribe to tribe; for every one of the children of Israel shall keep to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
texts.num.36.8: And every daughter that possesseth an inheritance among the tribes of the children of Israel, shall be married to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every one the inheritance of his fathers,
texts.num.36.9: and the inheritance shall not pass from one tribe to another tribe; for each of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep to his inheritance.
texts.num.36.10: Even as Jehovah had commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad;
texts.num.36.11: and Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their uncles' sons.
texts.num.36.12: To those that were of the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph were they married; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
texts.num.36.13: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Jehovah commanded through Moses to the children of Israel, in the plains of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.

texts.num.1.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year of their going out of the land of Egypt, saying:
texts.num.1.2: `Take ye up the sum of all the company of the sons of Israel by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names -- every male by their polls;
texts.num.1.3: from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host in Israel, ye do number them by their hosts, thou and Aaron;
texts.num.1.4: and with you there is a man for a tribe, each is a head to the house of his fathers.
texts.num.1.5: `And these [are] the names of the men who stand with you: `For Reuben -- Elizur son of Shedeur.
texts.num.1.10: `For the sons of Joseph -- for Ephraim: Elishama son of Ammihud: for Manasseh -- Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
texts.num.1.16: These [are] those called of the company, princes of the tribes of their fathers; they [are] heads of the thousands of Israel.
texts.num.1.17: And Moses taketh -- Aaron also -- these men, who were defined by name,
texts.num.1.18: and all the company they assembled on the first of the second month, and they declare their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names from a son of twenty years and upward, by their polls,
texts.num.1.19: as Jehovah hath commanded Moses; and he numbereth them in the wilderness of Sinai.
texts.num.1.20: And the sons of Reuben, Israel's first-born -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, by their polls, every male from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.21: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Reuben, are six and forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.1.22: Of the sons of Simeon -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, its numbered ones in the number of names, by their polls, every male from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.23: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Simeon, [are] nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.
texts.num.1.24: Of the sons of Gad -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.25: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Gad, [are] five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.
texts.num.1.26: Of the sons of Judah -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.27: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Judah, [are] four and seventy thousand and six hundred.
texts.num.1.28: Of the sons of Issachar -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.29: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Issachar, [are] four and fifty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.30: Of the sons of Zebulun -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.31: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Zebulun, [are] seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.32: Of the sons of Joseph -- of the sons of Ephraim -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.33: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Ephraim, [are] forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.1.34: Of the sons of Manasseh -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.35: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Manasseh, [are] two and thirty thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.1.36: Of the sons of Benjamin -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.37: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Benjamin, [are] five and thirty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.38: Of the sons of Dan -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.39: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Dan, [are] two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.
texts.num.1.40: Of the sons of Asher -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.41: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Asher, [are] one and forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.1.42: [Of] the sons of Naphtali -- their births, by their families, by the house of their fathers, in the number of names, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host --
texts.num.1.43: their numbered ones, for the tribe of Naphtali, [are] three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.1.44: These [are] those numbered, whom Moses numbered -- Aaron also, and the princes of Israel, twelve men -- each for the house of his fathers, they have been.
texts.num.1.45: And they are, all those numbered of the sons of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from a son of twenty years and upward, every one going out to the host in Israel,
texts.num.1.46: yea, all those numbered are six hundred thousand, and three thousand, and five hundred and fifty.
texts.num.1.47: And the Levites, for the tribe of their fathers, have not numbered themselves in their midst,
texts.num.1.48: seeing Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.1.49: `Only, the tribe of Levi thou dost not number, and their sum thou dost not take up in the midst of the sons of Israel;
texts.num.1.50: and thou, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all that it hath; they bear the tabernacle, and all its vessels, and they serve it; and round about the tabernacle they encamp.
texts.num.1.51: `And in the journeying of the tabernacle, the Levites take it down, and in the encamping of the tabernacle, the Levites raise it up; and the stranger who is coming near is put to death.'
texts.num.1.52: And the sons of Israel have encamped, each by his camp, and each by his standard, by their hosts;
texts.num.1.53: and the Levites encamp round about the tabernacle of the testimony; and there is no wrath on the company of the sons of Israel, and the Levites have kept the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony.
texts.num.1.54: And the sons of Israel do according to all that Jehovah hath commanded Moses; so they have done.
texts.num.2.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, and unto Aaron, saying,
texts.num.2.2: `Each by his standard, with ensigns of the house of their fathers, do the sons of Israel encamp; over-against round about the tent of meeting they encamp.'
texts.num.2.3: And those encamping eastward towards the sun-rising, [are of] the standard of the camp of Judah, by their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Judah [is] Nahshon, son of Amminadab;
texts.num.2.4: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] four and seventy thousand and six hundred.
texts.num.2.5: And those encamping by him [are of] the tribe of Issachar; and the prince of the sons of Issachar [is] Nethaneel son of Zuar;
texts.num.2.6: and his host, and its numbered ones, [are] four and fifty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.7: The tribe of Zebulun; and the prince of the sons of Zebulun [is] Eliab son of Helon;
texts.num.2.8: and his host, and its numbered ones, [are] seven and fifty thousand and four hundred;
texts.num.2.9: all those numbered of the camp of Judah [are] a hundred thousand, and eighty thousand, and six thousand, and four hundred, by their hosts; they journey first.
texts.num.2.10: The standard of the camp of Reuben [is] southward, by their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Reuben [is] Elizur son of Shedeur;
texts.num.2.11: and his host, and its numbered ones, [are] six and forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.2.12: And those encamping by him [are of] the tribe of Simeon; and the prince of the sons of Simeon [is] Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
texts.num.2.13: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.
texts.num.2.14: And the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the sons of Gad [is] Eliasaph son of Reuel;
texts.num.2.15: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.
texts.num.2.16: All those numbered of the camp of Reuben [are] a hundred thousand, and one and fifty thousand, and four hundred and fifty, by their hosts; and they journey second.
texts.num.2.17: And the tent of meeting -- the camp of the Levites -- hath journeyed in the midst of the camps; as they encamp so they journey, each at his station by their standards.
texts.num.2.18: The standard of the camp of Ephraim, by their hosts, [is] westward; and the prince of the sons of Ephraim [is] Elishama son of Ammihud;
texts.num.2.19: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.2.20: And by him [is] the tribe of Manasseh; and the prince of the sons of Manasseh [is] Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
texts.num.2.21: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] two and thirty thousand, and two hundred.
texts.num.2.22: And the tribe of Benjamin; and the prince of the sons of Benjamin [is] Abidan son of Gideoni;
texts.num.2.23: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] five and thirty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.24: All those numbered of the camp of Ephraim [are] a hundred thousand, and eight thousand, and a hundred, by their hosts; and they journey third.
texts.num.2.25: The standard of the camp of Dan [is] northward, by their hosts; and the prince of the sons of Dan [is] Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
texts.num.2.26: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.
texts.num.2.27: And those encamping by him [are of] the tribe of Asher; and the prince of the sons of Asher [is] Pagiel son of Ocran;
texts.num.2.28: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] one and forty thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.2.29: And the tribe of Naphtali; and the prince of the sons of Naphtali [is] Ahira son of Enan;
texts.num.2.30: and his host, and their numbered ones, [are] three and fifty thousand and four hundred.
texts.num.2.31: All those numbered of the camp of Dan [are] a hundred thousand, and seven and fifty thousand, and six hundred; at the rear they journey, by their standards.
texts.num.2.32: These [are] those numbered of the sons of Israel by the house of their fathers; all those numbered of the camps by their hosts [are] six hundred thousand, and three thousand, and five hundred and fifty.
texts.num.2.33: And the Levites have not numbered themselves in the midst of the sons of Israel, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
texts.num.2.34: And the sons of Israel do according to all that Jehovah hath commanded Moses; so they have encamped by their standards, and so they have journeyed; each by his families, by the house of his fathers.
texts.num.3.1: And these [are] births of Aaron and Moses, in the day of Jehovah's speaking with Moses in mount Sinai.
texts.num.3.2: And these [are] the names of the sons of Aaron: the first-born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar;
texts.num.3.3: these [are] the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose hand he hath consecrated for acting as priest.
texts.num.3.4: And Nadab dieth -- Abihu also -- before Jehovah, in their bringing near strange fire before Jehovah, in the wilderness of Sinai, and sons they had not; and Eleazar -- Ithamar also -- acteth as priest in the presence of Aaron their father.
texts.num.3.5: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.6: `Bring near the tribe of Levi, and thou hast caused it to stand before Aaron the priest, and they have served him,
texts.num.3.7: and kept his charge, and the charge of all the company before the tent of meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle;
texts.num.3.8: and they have kept all the vessels of the tent of meeting, and the charge of the sons of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle;
texts.num.3.9: and thou hast given the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are surely given to him out of the sons of Israel.
texts.num.3.10: `And Aaron and his sons thou dost appoint, and they have kept their priesthood, and the stranger who cometh near is put to death.'
texts.num.3.11: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.12: `And I, lo, I have taken the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel instead of every first-born opening a womb among the sons of Israel, and the Levites have been Mine;
texts.num.3.13: for Mine [is] every first-born, in the day of My smiting every first-born in the land of Egypt I have sanctified to Myself every first-born in Israel, from man unto beast; Mine they are; I [am] Jehovah.'
texts.num.3.14: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
texts.num.3.15: `Number the sons of Levi by the house of their fathers, by their families; every male from a son of a month and upward thou dost number them.'
texts.num.3.16: And Moses numbereth them according to the command of Jehovah, as he hath been commanded.
texts.num.3.17: And these are sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
texts.num.3.18: And these [are] the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
texts.num.3.19: And the sons of Kohath, by their families, [are] Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
texts.num.3.20: And the sons of Merari by their families [are] Mahli and Mushi; these are the families of the Levites, by the house of their fathers.
texts.num.3.21: Of Gershon [is] the family of the Libnite, and the family of the Shimite; these are the families of the Gershonite.
texts.num.3.22: Their numbered ones, in number, every male from a son of a month and upward, their numbered ones [are] seven thousand and five hundred.
texts.num.3.23: The families of the Gershonite, behind the tabernacle, do encamp westward.
texts.num.3.24: And the prince of a father's house for the Gershonite [is] Eliasaph son of Lael.
texts.num.3.25: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting [is] the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the vail at the opening of the tent of meeting,
texts.num.3.26: and the hangings of the court, and the vail at the opening of the court, which [is] by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and its cords, to all its service.
texts.num.3.27: And of Kohath [is] the family of the Amramite, and the family of the Izharite, and the family of the Hebronite, and the family of the Uzzielite; these are families of the Kohathite.
texts.num.3.28: In number, all the males, from a son of a month and upward, [are] eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.29: The families of the sons of Kohath encamp by the side of the tabernacle southward.
texts.num.3.30: And the prince of a father's house for the families of the Kohathite [is] Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
texts.num.3.31: And their charge [is] the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary with which they serve, and the vail, and all its service.
texts.num.3.32: And [to] the prince of the princes of the Levites, Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, [is] the oversight of the keepers of the charge of the sanctuary.
texts.num.3.33: Of Merari [is] the family of the Mahlite, and the family of the Mushite; these [are] the families of Merari.
texts.num.3.34: And their numbered ones, in number, all the males from a son of a month and upward, [are] six thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.3.35: And the prince of a father's house for the families of Merari [is] Zuriel son of Abihail; by the side of the tabernacle they encamp northward.
texts.num.3.36: And the oversight -- the charge of the sons of Merari -- [is] the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all its vessels, and all its service,
texts.num.3.37: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
texts.num.3.38: And those encamping before the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting, at the east, [are] Moses and Aaron, and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the sons of Israel, and the stranger who cometh near is put to death.
texts.num.3.39: All those numbered of the Levites whom Moses numbered -- Aaron also -- by the command of Jehovah, by their families, every male from a son of a month and upward, [are] two and twenty thousand.
texts.num.3.40: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Number every first-born male of the sons of Israel from a son of a month and upward, and take up the number of their names;
texts.num.3.41: and thou hast taken the Levites for Me (I [am] Jehovah), instead of every first-born among the sons of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of every firstling among the cattle of the sons of Israel.'
texts.num.3.42: And Moses numbereth, as Jehovah hath commanded him, all the first-born among the sons of Israel.
texts.num.3.43: And all the first-born -- male -- by the number of names, from a son of a month and upward, of their numbered ones, are two and twenty thousand two hundred and seventy and three.
texts.num.3.44: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.3.45: `Take the Levites instead of every first-born among the sons of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites have been Mine; I [am] Jehovah.
texts.num.3.46: `And [from] those ransomed of the two hundred and seventy and three (who are more than the Levites) of the first-born of the sons of Israel,
texts.num.3.47: thou hast even taken five shekels a-piece by the poll -- by the shekel of the sanctuary thou takest; twenty gerahs the shekel [is];
texts.num.3.48: and thou hast given the money to Aaron, and to his sons, whereby those over and above are ransomed.'
texts.num.3.49: And Moses taketh the ransom money from those over and above those ransomed by the Levites;
texts.num.3.50: from the first-born of the sons of Israel he hath taken the money, a thousand and three hundred and sixty and five -- by the shekel of the sanctuary;
texts.num.3.51: and Moses giveth the money of those ransomed to Aaron, and to his sons, according to the command of Jehovah, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
texts.num.4.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, and unto Aaron, saying,
texts.num.4.2: `Take up the sum of the sons of Kohath from the midst of the sons of Levi, by their families, by the house of their fathers;
texts.num.4.3: from a son of thirty years and upward, even till a son of fifty years, every one going in to the host, to do work in the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.4: `This [is] the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting, the holy of holies:
texts.num.4.5: that Aaron and his sons have come in, in the journeying of the camp, and have taken down the vail of the hanging, and have covered with it the ark of the testimony;
texts.num.4.6: and have put on it a covering of badger skin, and have spread a garment completely of blue above, and have placed its staves.
texts.num.4.7: `And on the table of the presence they spread a garment of blue, and have put on it the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and the cups of the libation, and the bread of continuity is on it,
texts.num.4.8: and they have spread over them a garment of scarlet, and have covered it with a covering of badger skin, and have placed its staves,
texts.num.4.9: and have taken a garment of blue, and have covered the candlestick of the lamp, and its lights, and its snuffers, and its snuff-dishes, and all its oil vessels wherewith they minister to it;
texts.num.4.10: and they have put it and all its vessels unto a covering of badger skin, and have put [it] on the bar.
texts.num.4.11: `And on the golden altar they spread a garment of blue, and have covered it with a covering of badger skin, and have placed its staves;
texts.num.4.12: and have taken all the vessels of ministry wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and have put [them] unto a garment of blue, and have covered them with a covering of badger skin, and have put [them] on the bar,
texts.num.4.13: and have removed the ashes of the altar, and have spread over it a garment of purple;
texts.num.4.14: and have put on it all its vessels wherewith they minister about it, the censers, the hooks, and the shovels, and the bowls, all the vessels of the altar, and have spread on it a covering of badger skin, and have placed its staves:
texts.num.4.15: `And Aaron hath finished -- his sons also -- covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, in the journeying of the camp, and afterwards do the sons of Kohath come in to bear [it], and they do not come unto the holy thing, that they have died; these [things are] the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.16: `And the oversight of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, [is] the oil of the lamp, and the spice-perfume, and the present of continuity, and the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that [is] in it, in the sanctuary, and in its vessels.'
texts.num.4.17: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
texts.num.4.18: `Ye do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathite from the midst of the Levites;
texts.num.4.19: but this do to them, and they have lived, and do not die in their drawing nigh the holy of holies: -- Aaron and his sons go in, and have set them, each man to his service, and unto his burden,
texts.num.4.20: and they go not in to see when the holy thing is swallowed, that they have died.'
texts.num.4.21: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.4.22: `Take up the sum of the sons of Gershon also by the house of their fathers, by their families;
texts.num.4.23: from a son of thirty years and upward, till a son of fifty years thou dost number them, every one who is going in to serve the host, to do the service in the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.24: `This [is] the service of the families of the Gershonite, to serve -- and for burden,
texts.num.4.25: and they have borne the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of the badger [skin] which [is] on it above, and the vail at the opening of the tent of meeting,
texts.num.4.26: and the hangings of the court, and the vail at the opening of the gate of the court which [is] by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the vessels of their service, and all that is made for them -- and they have served.
texts.num.4.27: `By the command of Aaron and his sons is all the service of the sons of the Gershonite in all their burden, and in all their service; and ye have laid a charge on them concerning the charge of all their burden.
texts.num.4.28: This [is] the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonite in the tent of meeting; and their charge [is] under the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
texts.num.4.29: `The sons of Merari, by their families, by the house of their fathers, thou dost number them;
texts.num.4.30: from a son of thirty years and upward even unto a son of fifty years thou dost number them, every one who is going in to the host, to do the service of the tent of meeting.
texts.num.4.31: `And this [is] the charge of their burden, of all their service in the tent of meeting; the boards of the tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets,
texts.num.4.32: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, of all their vessels, and of all their service; and by name ye do number the vessels of the charge of their burden.
texts.num.4.33: `This [is] the service of the families of the sons of Merari, for all their service, in the tent of meeting, by the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.'
texts.num.4.34: And Moses numbereth -- Aaron also, and the princes of the company -- the sons of the Kohathite, by their families, and by the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.35: from a son of thirty years and upward even unto a son of fifty years, every one who is going in to the host, for service in the tent of meeting,
texts.num.4.36: and their numbered ones, by their families, are two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
texts.num.4.37: These [are] those numbered of the families of the Kohathite, every one who is serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, by the command of Jehovah, by the hand of Moses.
texts.num.4.38: And those numbered of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.39: from a son of thirty years and upward even unto a son of fifty years, every one who is going in to the host, for service in the tent of meeting,
texts.num.4.40: even their numbered ones, by their families, by the house of their fathers, are two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
texts.num.4.41: These [are] those numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, every one who is serving in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered by the command of Jehovah.
texts.num.4.42: And those numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.43: from a son of thirty years and upward even unto a son of fifty years, every one who is going in to the host, for service in the tent of meeting,
texts.num.4.44: even their numbered ones, by their families, are three thousand and two hundred.
texts.num.4.45: These [are] those numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, by the command of Jehovah, by the hand of Moses.
texts.num.4.46: All those numbered, whom Moses numbered -- Aaron also, and the princes of Israel -- of the Levites, by their families, and by the house of their fathers,
texts.num.4.47: from a son of thirty years and upward even unto a son of fifty years, every one who is going in to do the work of the service, even the service of burden in the tent of meeting,
texts.num.4.48: even their numbered ones are eight thousand and five hundred and eighty;
texts.num.4.49: by the command of Jehovah hath [one] numbered them, by the hand of Moses, each man by his service, and by his burden, with his numbered ones, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
texts.num.5.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.5.2: `Command the sons of Israel, and they send out of the camp every leper, and every one with an issue, and every one defiled by a body;
texts.num.5.3: from male unto female ye do send out; unto the outside of the camp ye do send them; and they defile not their camps in the midst of which I do tabernacle.'
texts.num.5.4: And the sons of Israel do so, and they send them out unto the outside of the camp; as Jehovah hath spoken unto Moses so have the sons of Israel done.
texts.num.5.5: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.5.6: `Speak unto the sons of Israel, Man or woman, when they do any of the sins of man, by committing a trespass against Jehovah, and that person [is] guilty,
texts.num.5.7: and they have confessed their sin which they have done, then he hath restored his guilt in its principal, and its fifth is adding to it, and hath given [it] to him in reference to whom he hath been guilty.
texts.num.5.8: `And if the man have no redeemer to restore the guilt to, the guilt which is restored [is] Jehovah's, the priest's, apart from the ram of the atonements, whereby he maketh atonement for him.
texts.num.5.9: `And every heave-offering of all the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they bring near to the priest, becometh his;
texts.num.5.10: and any man's hallowed things become his; that which any man giveth to the priest becometh his.'
texts.num.5.11: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.5.12: `Speak unto the sons of Israel, and thou hast said unto them, When any man's wife turneth aside, and hath committed against him a trespass,
texts.num.5.13: and a man hath lain with her [with] the seed of copulation, and it hath been hid from the eyes of her husband, and concealed, and she hath been defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she hath not been caught,
texts.num.5.14: and a spirit of jealousy hath passed over him, and he hath been jealous of his wife, and she hath been defiled; -- or, a spirit of jealousy hath passed over him, and he hath been jealous of his wife, and she hath not been defiled --
texts.num.5.15: `Then hath the man brought in his wife unto the priest, and he hath brought in her offering for her, a tenth of the ephah of barley meal, he doth not pour on it oil, nor doth he put on it frankincense, for it [is] a present of jealousy, a present of memorial, causing remembrance of iniquity.
texts.num.5.16: `And the priest hath brought her near, and hath caused her to stand before Jehovah,
texts.num.5.17: and the priest hath taken holy water in an earthen vessel, and of the dust which is on the floor of the tabernacle doth the priest take, and hath put [it] into the water,
texts.num.5.18: and the priest hath caused the woman to stand before Jehovah, and hath uncovered the woman's head, and hath given into her hands the present of the memorial, it [is] a present of jealousy, and in the hand of the priest are the bitter waters which cause the curse.
texts.num.5.19: `And the priest hath caused her to swear, and hath said unto the woman, If no man hath lain with thee, and if thou hast not turned aside [to] uncleanness under thy husband, be free from these bitter waters which cause the curse;
texts.num.5.20: and thou, if thou hast turned aside under thy husband, and if thou hast been defiled, and any man doth give his copulation to thee besides thy husband --
texts.num.5.21: (then the priest hath caused the woman to swear with an oath of execration, and the priest hath said to the woman) -- Jehovah doth give thee for an execration, and for a curse, in the midst of thy people, in Jehovah's giving thy thigh to fall, and thy belly to swell,
texts.num.5.22: and these waters which cause the curse have gone into thy bowels, to cause the belly to swell, and the thigh to fall; and the woman hath said, Amen, Amen.
texts.num.5.23: `And the priest hath written these execrations in a book, and hath blotted [them] out with the bitter waters,
texts.num.5.24: and hath caused the woman to drink the bitter waters which cause the curse, and the waters which cause the curse have entered into her for bitter things.
texts.num.5.25: `And the priest hath taken out of the hand of the woman the present of jealousy, and hath waved the present before Jehovah, and hath brought it near unto the altar;
texts.num.5.26: and the priest hath taken a handful of the present, its memorial, and hath made perfume on the altar, and afterwards doth cause the woman to drink the water:
texts.num.5.27: yea, he hath caused her to drink the water, and it hath come to pass, if she hath been defiled, and doth commit a trespass against her husband, that the waters which cause the curse have gone into her for bitter things, and her belly hath swelled, and her thigh hath fallen, and the woman hath become an execration in the midst of her people.
texts.num.5.28: `And if the woman hath not been defiled, and is clean, then she hath been acquitted, and hath been sown [with] seed.
texts.num.5.29: `This [is] the law of jealousies, when a wife turneth aside under her husband, and hath been defiled,
texts.num.5.30: or when a spirit of jealousy passeth over a man, and he hath been jealous of his wife, then he hath caused the woman to stand before Jehovah, and the priest hath done to her all this law,
texts.num.5.31: and the man hath been acquitted from iniquity, and that woman doth bear her iniquity.'
texts.num.6.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.6.2: `Speak unto the sons of Israel, and thou hast said unto them, When a man or woman doeth singularly, by vowing a vow of a Nazarite, to be separate to Jehovah;
texts.num.6.3: from wine and strong drink he doth keep separate; vinegar of wine, and vinegar of strong drink he doth not drink, and any juice of grapes he doth not drink, and grapes moist or dry he doth not eat;
texts.num.6.4: all days of his separation, of anything which is made of the wine-vine, from kernels even unto husk, he doth not eat.
texts.num.6.5: `All days of the vow of his separation a razor doth not pass over his head; till the fulness of the days which he doth separate to Jehovah he is holy; grown up hath the upper part of the hair of his head.
texts.num.6.6: `All days of his keeping separate to Jehovah, near a dead person he doth not go;
texts.num.6.7: for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister -- he is not unclean for them at their death, for the separation of his God [is] on his head;
texts.num.6.8: all days of his separation he [is] holy to Jehovah.
texts.num.6.9: `And when the dead dieth beside him in an instant, suddenly, and he hath defiled the head of his separation, then he hath shaved his head in the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he doth shave it,
texts.num.6.10: and on the eighth day he bringeth in two turtle-doves or two young pigeons unto the priest, unto the opening of the tent of meeting,
texts.num.6.11: and the priest hath prepared one for a sin-offering, and one for a burnt-offering, and hath made atonement for him, because of that which he hath sinned by the body, and he hath hallowed his head on that day;
texts.num.6.12: and he hath separated to Jehovah the days of his separation, and he hath brought in a lamb, a son of a year, for a guilt-offering, and the former days are fallen, for his separation hath been defiled.
texts.num.6.13: `And this [is] the law of the Nazarite; in the day of the fulness of the days of his separation doth [one] bring him in unto the opening of the tent of meeting,
texts.num.6.14: and he hath brought near his offering to Jehovah, one he-lamb, a son of a year, a perfect one, for a burnt-offering, and one she-lamb, a daughter of a year, a perfect one, for a sin-offering, and one ram, a perfect one, for peace-offerings,
texts.num.6.15: and a basket of unleavened things of flour, cakes mixed with oil, and thin cakes of unleavened things anointed with oil, and their present, and their libations.
texts.num.6.16: `And the priest hath brought [them] near before Jehovah, and hath made his sin-offering and his burnt-offering;
texts.num.6.17: and the ram he maketh a sacrifice of peace-offerings to Jehovah, besides the basket of unleavened things; and the priest hath made its present and its libation.
texts.num.6.18: `And the Nazarite hath shaved (at the opening of the tent of meeting) the head of his separation, and hath taken the hair of the head of his separation, and hath put [it] on the fire which [is] under the sacrifice of the peace-offerings.
texts.num.6.19: `And the priest hath taken the boiled shoulder from the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one thin unleavened cake, and hath put on the palms of the Nazarite after his shaving his separation;
texts.num.6.20: and the priest hath waved them, a wave-offering before Jehovah; it [is] holy to the priest, besides the breast of the wave-offering, and besides the leg of the heave-offering; and afterwards doth the Nazarite drink wine.
texts.num.6.21: `This [is] the law of the Nazarite, who voweth his offering to Jehovah for his separation, apart from that which his hand attaineth; according to his vow which he voweth so he doth by the law of his separation.'
texts.num.6.22: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.6.23: `Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, saying, Thus ye do bless the sons of Israel, saying to them,
texts.num.6.25: `Jehovah cause His face to shine upon thee, and favour thee;
texts.num.6.26: `Jehovah lift up His countenance upon thee, and appoint for thee -- peace.
texts.num.6.27: `And they have put My name upon the sons of Israel, and I -- I do bless them.'
texts.num.7.1: And it cometh to pass on the day of Moses' finishing setting up the tabernacle, that he anointeth it, and sanctifieth it, and all its vessels, and the altar, and all its vessels, and he anointeth them, and sanctifieth them,
texts.num.7.2: and the princes of Israel (heads of the house of their fathers, they [are] princes of the tribes, they who are standing over those numbered) bring near,
texts.num.7.3: yea, they bring their offering before Jehovah, six waggons covered, and twelve oxen -- a waggon for two of the princes, and an ox for one -- and they bring them near before the tabernacle.
texts.num.7.4: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.7.5: `Receive from them, and they have been to do the service of the tent of meeting, and thou hast given them unto the Levites, each according to his service.'
texts.num.7.6: And Moses taketh the waggons and the oxen, and giveth them unto the Levites.
texts.num.7.7: The two of the waggons and the four of the oxen he hath given to the sons of Gershon, according to their service,
texts.num.7.8: and the four of the waggons and the eight of the oxen he hath given to the sons of Merari, according to their service, by the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest;
texts.num.7.9: and to the sons of Kohath he hath not given, for the service of the sanctuary [is] on them: on the shoulder they bear.
texts.num.7.10: And the princes bring near the dedication of the altar in the day of its being anointed; yea, the princes bring near their offering before the altar.
texts.num.7.11: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `One prince a day -- one prince a day -- do they bring near their offering for the dedication of the altar.'
texts.num.7.12: And he who is bringing near on the first day his offering is Nahshon son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah.
texts.num.7.13: And his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.14: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.15: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.16: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.17: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.
texts.num.7.18: On the second day hath Nethaneel son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, brought near.
texts.num.7.19: He hath brought near his offering, one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.20: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.21: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.22: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.23: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Nethaneel son of Zuar.
texts.num.7.24: On the third day, the prince of the sons of Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon; --
texts.num.7.25: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.26: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.27: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.28: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.29: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Eliab son of Helon.
texts.num.7.30: On the fourth day, Elizur, son of Shedeur, prince of the sons of Reuben; --
texts.num.7.31: his offering is one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.32: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.33: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.34: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.35: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Elizur son of Shedeur.
texts.num.7.36: On the fifth day, the prince of the sons of Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai; --
texts.num.7.37: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.38: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.39: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.40: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.41: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
texts.num.7.42: On the sixth day, the prince of the sons of Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel; --
texts.num.7.43: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.44: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.45: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.46: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.47: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Eliasaph son of Deuel.
texts.num.7.48: On the seventh day, the prince of the sons of Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; --
texts.num.7.49: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.50: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.51: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.52: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.53: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Elishama son of Ammihud.
texts.num.7.54: On the eighth day, the prince of the sons of Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur; --
texts.num.7.55: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.56: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.57: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.58: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.59: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
texts.num.7.60: On the ninth day, the prince of the sons of Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni; --
texts.num.7.61: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.62: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.63: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.64: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering:
texts.num.7.65: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Abidan son of Gideoni.
texts.num.7.66: On the tenth day, the prince of the sons of Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai; --
texts.num.7.67: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.68: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.69: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.70: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.71: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
texts.num.7.72: On the eleventh day, the prince of the sons of Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran; --
texts.num.7.73: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.74: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.75: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.76: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.77: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Pagiel son of Ocran.
texts.num.7.78: On the twelfth day, the prince of the sons of Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan; --
texts.num.7.79: his offering [is] one silver dish, its weight a hundred and thirty [shekels]; one silver bowl of seventy shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of flour mixed with oil, for a present;
texts.num.7.80: one golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of perfume;
texts.num.7.81: one bullock, a son of the herd, one ram, one lamb, a son of a year, for a burnt-offering;
texts.num.7.82: one kid of the goats for a sin-offering;
texts.num.7.83: and for a sacrifice of the peace-offerings two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five lambs, sons of a year; this [is] the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
texts.num.7.84: This [is] the dedication of the altar, in the day of its being anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden spoons;
texts.num.7.85: a hundred and thirty [shekels] each silver dish, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels [is] two thousand and four hundred [shekels], by the shekel of the sanctuary.
texts.num.7.86: Golden spoons [are] twelve, full of perfume; ten [shekels] each spoon, by the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the spoons [is] a hundred and twenty [shekels];
texts.num.7.87: all the oxen for burnt-offering [are] twelve bullocks, rams twelve, lambs, sons of a year twelve, and their present; and kids of the goats twelve, for sin-offering;
texts.num.7.88: and all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace-offerings [are] twenty and four bullocks, rams sixty, he-goats sixty, lambs, sons of a year, sixty; this is the dedication of the altar, in the day of its being anointed.
texts.num.7.89: And in the going in of Moses unto the tent of meeting to speak with Him -- he doth even hear the voice speaking unto him from off the mercy-seat which [is] upon the ark of the testimony, from between the two cherubs; and He speaketh unto him.
texts.num.8.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.8.2: `Speak unto Aaron, and thou hast said unto him, In thy causing the lights to go up, over-against the face of the candlestick do the seven lights give light.'
texts.num.8.3: And Aaron doth so; over-against the face of the candlestick he hath caused its lights to go up, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
texts.num.8.4: And this [is] the work of the candlestick: beaten work of gold; unto its thigh, unto its flower it [is] beaten work; as the appearance which Jehovah shewed Moses, so he hath made the candlestick.
texts.num.8.5: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.8.6: `Take the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and thou hast cleansed them.
texts.num.8.7: `And thus thou dost to them to cleanse them: sprinkle upon them waters of atonement, and they have caused a razor to pass over all their flesh, and have washed their garments, and cleansed themselves,
texts.num.8.8: and have taken a bullock, a son of the herd, and its present, flour mixed with oil, -- and a second bullock a son of the herd thou dost take for a sin-offering,
texts.num.8.9: and thou hast brought near the Levites before the tent of meeting, and thou hast assembled the whole company of the sons of Israel,
texts.num.8.10: and thou hast brought near the Levites before Jehovah, and the sons of Israel have laid their hands on the Levites,
texts.num.8.11: and Aaron hath waved the Levites -- a wave-offering before Jehovah, from the sons of Israel, and they have been -- for doing the service of Jehovah.
texts.num.8.12: `And the Levites lay their hands on the head of the bullocks, and make thou the one a sin-offering, and the one a burnt-offering to Jehovah, to atone for the Levites,
texts.num.8.13: and thou hast caused the Levites to stand before Aaron, and before his sons, and hast waved them -- a wave-offering to Jehovah;
texts.num.8.14: and thou hast separated the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and the Levites have become Mine;
texts.num.8.15: and afterwards do the Levites come in to serve the tent of meeting, and thou hast cleansed them, and hast waved them -- a wave-offering.
texts.num.8.16: `For they are certainly given to Me out of the midst of the sons of Israel, instead of him who openeth any womb -- the first-born of all -- from the sons of Israel I have taken them to Myself;
texts.num.8.17: for Mine [is] every first-born among the sons of Israel, among man and among beast; in the day of my smiting every first-born in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for Myself;
texts.num.8.18: and I take the Levites instead of every first-born among the sons of Israel:
texts.num.8.19: `And I give the Levites gifts to Aaron and to his sons, from the midst of the sons of Israel, to do the service of the sons of Israel in the tent of meeting, and to make atonement for the sons of Israel, and there is no plague among the sons of Israel in the sons of Israel's drawing nigh unto the sanctuary.'
texts.num.8.20: And Moses doth -- Aaron also, and all the company of the sons of Israel -- to the Levites according to all that Jehovah hath commanded Moses concerning the Levites; so have the sons of Israel done to them.
texts.num.8.21: And the Levites cleanse themselves, and wash their garments, and Aaron waveth them a wave-offering before Jehovah, and Aaron maketh atonement for them to cleanse them,
texts.num.8.22: and afterwards have the Levites gone in to do their service in the tent of meeting, before Aaron and before his sons; as Jehovah hath commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they have done to them.
texts.num.8.23: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.8.24: `This [is] that which [is] the Levites': from a son of five and twenty years and upward he doth go in to serve the host in the service of the tent of meeting,
texts.num.8.25: and from a son of fifty years he doth return from the host of the service, and doth not serve any more,
texts.num.8.26: and he hath ministered with his brethren in the tent of meeting, to keep the charge, and doth not do service; thus thou dost to the Levites concerning their charge.'
texts.num.9.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year of their going out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
texts.num.9.2: `Also, the sons of Israel prepare the passover in its appointed season;
texts.num.9.3: in the fourteenth day of this month between the evenings ye prepare it in its appointed season; according to all its statutes, and according to all its ordinances ye prepare it.'
texts.num.9.4: And Moses speaketh unto the sons of Israel to prepare the passover,
texts.num.9.5: and they prepare the passover in the first [month], on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, in the wilderness of Sinai; according to all that Jehovah hath commanded Moses, so have the sons of Israel done.
texts.num.9.6: And there are men who have been defiled by the body of a man, and they have not been able to prepare the passover on that day, and they come near before Moses, and before Aaron, on that day,
texts.num.9.7: and those men say unto him, `We are defiled by the body of a man; why are we withheld so as not to bring near the offering of Jehovah in its appointed season, in the midst of the sons of Israel?'
texts.num.9.8: And Moses saith unto them, `Stand ye, and I hear what Jehovah hath commanded concerning you.'
texts.num.9.9: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.9.10: `Speak unto the sons of Israel, saying, Though any man is unclean by a body or in a distant journey (of you or of your generations), yet he hath prepared a passover to Jehovah;
texts.num.9.11: in the second month, on the fourteenth day, between the evenings they prepare it; with unleavened and bitter things they eat it;
texts.num.9.12: they do not leave of till morning; and a bone they do not break in it: according to all the statute of the passover they prepare it.
texts.num.9.13: `And the man who is clean, and hath not been on a journey, and hath ceased to prepare the passover, even that person hath been cut off from his people; because the offering of Jehovah he hath not brought near, in its appointed season, that man doth bear his sin.
texts.num.9.14: `And when a sojourner sojourneth with you, then he hath prepared a passover to Jehovah, according to the statute of the passover, and according to its ordinance, so he doth; one statute is to you, even to a sojourner, and to a native of the land.'
texts.num.9.15: And in the day of the raising up of the tabernacle hath the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the tent of the testimony; and in the evening there is on the tabernacle as an appearance of fire till morning;
texts.num.9.16: so it is continually; the cloud covereth it, also the appearance of fire by night.
texts.num.9.17: And according to the going up of the cloud from off the tent and afterwards do the sons of Israel journey; and in the place where the cloud doth tabernacle, there do the sons of Israel encamp;
texts.num.9.18: by the command of Jehovah the sons of Israel journey, and by the command of Jehovah they encamp; all the days that the cloud doth tabernacle over the tabernacle they encamp.
texts.num.9.19: And in the cloud prolonging itself over the tabernacle many days, then have the sons of Israel kept the charge of Jehovah, and journey not,
texts.num.9.20: and so when the cloud is a number of days over the tabernacle; by the command of Jehovah they encamp, and by the command of Jehovah they journey.
texts.num.9.21: And so when the cloud is from evening till morning, when the cloud hath gone up in the morning, then they have journeyed; whether by day or by night, when the cloud hath gone up, then they have journeyed.
texts.num.9.22: Whether two days, or a month, or days, in the cloud prolonging itself over the tabernacle, to tabernacle over it, the sons of Israel encamp, and journey not; and in its being lifted up they journey;
texts.num.9.23: by the command of Jehovah they encamp, and by the command of Jehovah they journey; the charge of Jehovah they have kept, by the command of Jehovah in the hand of Moses.
texts.num.10.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.10.2: `Make to thee two trumpets of silver; beaten work thou dost make them, and they have been to thee for the convocation of the company, and for the journeying of the camps;
texts.num.10.3: and they have blown with them, and all the company have met together unto thee, unto the opening of the tent of meeting.
texts.num.10.4: And if with one they blow, then have the princes, heads of the thousands of Israel, met together unto thee;
texts.num.10.5: `And ye have blown -- a shout, and the camps which are encamping eastward have journeyed.
texts.num.10.6: `And ye have blown -- a second shout, and the camps which are encamping southward have journeyed; a shout they blow for their journeys.
texts.num.10.7: `And in the assembling of the assembly ye blow, and do not shout;
texts.num.10.8: and sons of Aaron, the priests, blow with the trumpets; and they have been to you for a statute age-during to your generations.
texts.num.10.9: `And when ye go into battle in your land against the adversary who is distressing you, then ye have shouted with the trumpets, and ye have been remembered before Jehovah your God, and ye have been saved from your enemies.
texts.num.10.10: `And in the day of your gladness, and in your appointed seasons, and in the beginnings of your months, ye have blown also with the trumpets over your burnt-offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings, and they have been to you for a memorial before your God; I, Jehovah, [am] your God.'
texts.num.10.11: And it cometh to pass -- in the second year, in the second month, in the twentieth of the month -- the cloud hath gone up from off the tabernacle of the testimony,
texts.num.10.12: and the sons of Israel journey in their journeyings from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud doth tabernacle in the wilderness of Paran;
texts.num.10.13: and they journey at first, by the command of Jehovah, in the hand of Moses.
texts.num.10.14: And the standard of the camp of the sons of Judah journeyeth in the first [place], by their hosts, and over its host [is] Nahshon son of Amminadab.
texts.num.10.15: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Issachar [is] Nathaneel son of Zuar.
texts.num.10.16: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun [is] Eliab son of Helon;
texts.num.10.17: And the tabernacle hath been taken down, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari have journeyed, bearing the tabernacle.
texts.num.10.18: And the standard of the camp of Reuben hath journeyed, by their hosts, and over its host [is] Elizur son of Shedeur.
texts.num.10.19: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Simeon [is] Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
texts.num.10.20: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Gad [is] Eliasaph son of Deuel;
texts.num.10.21: And the Kohathites have journeyed, bearing the tabernacle, and the [others] have raised up the tabernacle until their coming in.
texts.num.10.22: And the standard of the camp of the sons of Ephraim hath journeyed, by their hosts, and over its host [is] Elishama son of Ammihud.
texts.num.10.23: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh [is] Gamalial son of Pedahzur.
texts.num.10.24: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin [is] Abidan son of Gideoni.
texts.num.10.25: And the standard of the camp of the sons of Dan hath journeyed (rearward to all the camps), by their hosts, and over its host [is] Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
texts.num.10.26: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Asher [is] Pagiel son of Ocran.
texts.num.10.27: And over the host of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali [is] Ahira son of Enan.
texts.num.10.28: These [are] journeyings of the sons of Israel by their hosts -- and they journey.
texts.num.10.29: And Moses saith to Hobab son of Raguel the Midianite, father-in-law of Moses, `We are journeying unto the place of which Jehovah hath said, I give it to you; go with us, and we have done good to thee; for Jehovah hath spoken good concerning Israel.'
texts.num.10.30: And he saith unto him, `I do not go; but unto my land and unto my kindred do I go.'
texts.num.10.31: And he saith, `I pray thee, forsake us not, because thou hast known our encamping in the wilderness, and thou hast been to us for eyes;
texts.num.10.32: and it hath come to pass when thou goest with us, yea, it hath come to pass -- that good which Jehovah doth kindly with us -- it we have done kindly to thee.'
texts.num.10.33: And they journey from the mount of Jehovah a journey of three days; and the ark of the covenant of Jehovah is journeying before them the journey of three days, to spy out for them a resting-place;
texts.num.10.34: and the cloud of Jehovah [is] on them by day, in their journeying from the camp.
texts.num.10.35: And it cometh to pass in the journeying of the ark, that Moses saith, `Rise, O Jehovah, and Thine enemies are scattered, and those hating Thee flee from Thy presence.'
texts.num.10.36: And in its resting he saith, `Return, O Jehovah, [to] the myriads, the thousands of Israel.'
texts.num.11.1: And the people is evil, as those sighing habitually in the ears of Jehovah, and Jehovah heareth, and His anger burneth, and the fire of Jehovah burneth among them, and consumeth in the extremity of the camp.
texts.num.11.2: And the people cry unto Moses, and Moses prayeth unto Jehovah, and the fire is quenched;
texts.num.11.3: and he calleth the name of that place Taberah, for the fire of Jehovah hath `burned' among them.
texts.num.11.4: And the rabble who [are] in its midst have lusted greatly, and the sons of Israel also turn back and weep, and say, `Who doth give us flesh?
texts.num.11.5: We have remembered the fish which we do eat in Egypt for nought, the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick;
texts.num.11.6: and now our soul [is] dry, there is not anything, save the manna, before our eyes.'
texts.num.11.7: And the manna is as coriander seed, and its aspect as the aspect of bdolach;
texts.num.11.8: the people have turned aside and gathered [it], and ground [it] with millstones, or beat [it] in a mortar, and boiled [it] in a pan, and made it cakes, and its taste hath been as the taste of the moisture of oil.
texts.num.11.9: And in the descending of the dew on the camp by night, the manna descendeth upon it.
texts.num.11.10: And Moses heareth the people weeping by its families, each at the opening of his tent, and the anger of Jehovah burneth exceedingly, and in the eyes of Moses [it is] evil.
texts.num.11.11: And Moses saith unto Jehovah, `Why hast Thou done evil to Thy servant? and why have I not found grace in Thine eyes -- to put the burden of all this people upon me?
texts.num.11.12: I -- have I conceived all this people? I -- have I begotten it, that Thou sayest unto me, Carry it in thy bosom as the nursing father beareth the suckling, unto the ground which Thou hast sworn to its fathers?
texts.num.11.13: Whence have I flesh to give to all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give to us flesh, and we eat.
texts.num.11.14: I am not able -- I alone -- to bear all this people, for [it is] too heavy for me;
texts.num.11.15: and if thus Thou art doing to me -- slay me, I pray Thee; slay, if I have found grace in thine eyes, and let me not look on mine affliction.'
texts.num.11.16: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Gather to Me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou hast known that they are elders of the people, and its authorities; and thou hast taken them unto the tent of meeting, and they have stationed themselves there with thee,
texts.num.11.17: and I have come down and spoken with thee there, and have kept back of the Spirit which [is] upon thee, and have put on them, and they have borne with thee some of the burden of the people, and thou dost not bear [it] thyself alone.
texts.num.11.18: `And unto the people thou dost say, Sanctify yourselves for to-morrow, and ye have eaten flesh (for ye have wept in the ears of Jehovah, saying, Who doth give us flesh? for we [had] good in Egypt) -- and Jehovah hath given to you flesh, and ye have eaten.
texts.num.11.19: Ye do not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days; --
texts.num.11.20: unto a month of days, till that it come out from your nostrils, and it hath become to you an abomination; because that ye have loathed Jehovah, who [is] in your midst, and weep before Him, saying, Why is this? -- we have come out of Egypt!'
texts.num.11.21: And Moses saith, `Six hundred thousand footmen [are] the people in whose midst I [am]; and Thou, Thou hast said, Flesh I give to them, and they have eaten, a month of days!
texts.num.11.22: Is flock and herd slaughtered for them, that one hath found for them? -- are all the fishes of the sea gathered for them -- that one hath found for them?'
texts.num.11.23: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `Is the hand of Jehovah become short? now thou dost see whether My word meeteth thee or not.'
texts.num.11.24: And Moses goeth out, and speaketh unto the people the words of Jehovah, and gathereth seventy men of the elders of the people, and causeth them to stand round about the tent,
texts.num.11.25: and Jehovah cometh down in the cloud, and speaketh unto him, and keepeth back of the Spirit which [is] on him, and putteth on the seventy men of the elders; and it cometh to pass at the resting of the Spirit on them, that they prophesy, and do not cease.
texts.num.11.26: And two of the men are left in the camp, the name of the one [is] Eldad, and the name of the second Medad, and the spirit resteth upon them, (and they are among those written, and have not gone out to the tent), and they prophesy in the camp;
texts.num.11.27: and the young man runneth, and declareth to Moses, and saith, `Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.'
texts.num.11.28: And Joshua son of Nun, minister of Moses, [one] of his young men, answereth and saith, `My lord Moses, restrain them.'
texts.num.11.29: And Moses saith to him, `Art thou zealous for me? O that all Jehovah's people were prophets! that Jehovah would put His Spirit upon them!'
texts.num.11.30: And Moses is gathered unto the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
texts.num.11.31: And a spirit hath journeyed from Jehovah, and cutteth off quails from the sea, and leaveth by the camp, as a day's journey here, and as a day's journey there, round about the camp, and about two cubits, on the face of the land.
texts.num.11.32: And the people rise all that day, and all the night, and all the day after, and gather the quails -- he who hath least hath gathered ten homers -- and they spread them out for themselves round about the camp.
texts.num.11.33: The flesh is yet between their teeth -- it is not yet cut off -- and the anger of Jehovah hath burned among the people, and Jehovah smiteth among the people -- a very great smiting;
texts.num.11.34: and [one] calleth the name of that place Kibroth-Hattaavah, for there they have buried the people who lust.
texts.num.11.35: From Kibroth-Hattaavah have the people journeyed to Hazeroth, and they are in Hazeroth.
texts.num.12.1: And Miriam speaketh -- Aaron also -- against Moses concerning the circumstance of the Cushite woman whom he had taken: for a Cushite woman he had taken;
texts.num.12.2: and they say, `Only by Moses hath Jehovah spoken? also by us hath he not spoken?' and Jehovah heareth.
texts.num.12.3: And the man Moses [is] very humble, more than any of the men who [are] on the face of the ground.
texts.num.12.4: And Jehovah saith suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, `Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting;' and they three come out.
texts.num.12.5: And Jehovah cometh down in the pillar of the cloud, and standeth at the opening of the tent, and calleth Aaron and Miriam, and they come out both of them.
texts.num.12.6: And He saith, `Hear, I pray you, My words: If your prophet is of Jehovah -- in an appearance unto him I make Myself known; in a dream I speak with him;
texts.num.12.7: not so My servant Moses; in all My house he [is] stedfast;
texts.num.12.8: mouth unto mouth I speak with him, and [by] an appearance, and not in riddles; and the form of Jehovah he beholdeth attentively; and wherefore have ye not been afraid to speak against My servant -- against Moses?'
texts.num.12.9: And the anger of Jehovah burneth against them, and He goeth on,
texts.num.12.10: and the cloud hath turned aside from off the tent, and lo, Miriam [is] leprous as snow; and Aaron turneth unto Miriam, and lo, leprous!
texts.num.12.11: And Aaron saith unto Moses, `O, my lord, I pray thee, lay not upon us sin [in] which we have been foolish, and [in] which we have sinned;
texts.num.12.12: let her not, I pray thee, be as [one] dead, when in his coming out from the womb of his mother -- the half of his flesh is consumed.'
texts.num.12.13: And Moses crieth unto Jehovah, saying, `O God, I pray Thee, give, I pray Thee, healing to her.'
texts.num.12.14: And Jehovah saith unto Moses, `And her father had but spat in her face -- is she not ashamed seven days? she is shut out seven days at the outside of the camp, and afterwards she is gathered.'
texts.num.12.15: And Miriam is shut out at the outside of the camp seven days, and the people hath not journeyed till Miriam is gathered;
texts.num.12.16: and afterwards have the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and they encamp in the wilderness of Paran.
texts.num.13.1: And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
texts.num.13.2: `Send for thee men, and they spy the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel; one man, one man for the tribe of his fathers ye do send, every one a prince among them.'
texts.num.13.3: And Moses sendeth them from the wilderness of Paran by the command of Jehovah; all of them [are] men, heads of the sons of Israel they are,
texts.num.13.4: and these their names: For the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur.
texts.num.13.5: For the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori.
texts.num.13.6: For the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.
texts.num.13.7: For the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph.
texts.num.13.8: For the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea, son of Nun.
texts.num.13.9: For the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu.
texts.num.13.10: For the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi.
texts.num.13.11: For the tribe of Joseph, (for the tribe of Manasseh,) Gaddi son of Susi.
texts.num.13.12: For the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli.
texts.num.13.13: For the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael.
texts.num.13.14: For the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vopshi.
texts.num.13.15: For the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
texts.num.13.16: These [are] the names of the men whom Moses hath sent to spy the land; and Moses calleth Hoshea son of Nun, Jehoshua.
texts.num.13.17: And Moses sendeth them to spy the land of Canaan, and saith unto them, `Go ye up this [way] into the south, and ye have gone up the mountain,
texts.num.13.18: and have seen the land what it [is], and the people which is dwelling on it, whether it [is] strong or feeble; whether it [is] few or many;
texts.num.13.19: and what the land [is] in which it is dwelling, whether it [is] good or bad; and what [are] the cities in which it is dwelling, whether in camps or in fortresses;
texts.num.13.20: And what the land [is], whether it [is] fat or lean; whether there is wood in it or not; and ye have strengthened yourselves, and have taken of the fruit of the land;' and the days [are] days of the first-fruits of grapes.
